Job description:

We are seeking a highly skilled Full Stack Developer with 2 to 4 years of experience, possessing a deep expertise in SQL and strong proficiency in modern frontend frameworks. This role is tailored for a developer who thrives in data\-heavy environments and can build seamless, responsive user interfaces. The ideal candidate must be a SQL power user while maintaining strong hands\-on experience in React and Angular.

**Core Technical Requirements**

* **SQL:** Mandatory / Expert Level (Must have 2\-4 years of deep experience)
* **React:** Minimum 2 Years of professional experience
* **Angular:** Minimum 1 Year of professional experience

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in existing SQL scripts; perform execution plan analysis to optimize high\-latency queries.
* Architect scalable relational database schemas, ensuring proper normalization and data integrity for new product features.
* Develop and maintain scripts for data migration, transformation, and loading (ETL) between different environments or legacy systems.
* Move heavy computational logic to the database layer via stored procedures and functions where appropriate to reduce application\-layer overhead.
* Design and implement modular, reusable UI components in React using functional patterns and Hooks.
* Manage complex application states and data caching strategies to ensure a seamless user experience across high\-traffic modules.
* Ensure all frontend deliverables are responsive and performant across various browsers and mobile devices.
* Collaborate on the design of RESTful API contracts to ensure the frontend receives data in the most efficient structure possible.
* Implement best practices for data security, including SQL injection prevention, XSS protection, and secure handling of JWT or OAuth tokens.
* Integrate external services and APIs (e.g., payment gateways, messaging services, or analytics tools) into the core SaaS platform.
* Conduct thorough peer code reviews focusing on logic, SQL efficiency, and maintainability; maintain high unit\-test coverage for both frontend and database scripts.
* Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including ER diagrams, API documentation (Swagger/Postman), and deployment guides.
* Work with DevOps to streamline build processes and automate deployments, ensuring that SQL migrations are handled safely across environments.

**Qualifications \& Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Proven track record of 2–4 years in professional software development.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficiency with version control systems (Git) and Agile/Scrum methodologies.

* What is your Notice Period?

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

* SQL: 2 years (Preferred)
* HTML: 2 years (Preferred)

Language:

* English (Preferred)

With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.


We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!


Job Description


**Position (Title):** Country PMO Manager


**Location of the position:** Gurgaon


**Job summary**

You will be responsible for driving program management, project reviews, critical stakeholder connects and other critical actions in driving and promoting country business strategy, working with the office of MD of RA India.


We expect you to understand the business needs and to demonstrate collaboration with the internal stakeholders/Business units to enable country business strategy (BSR).


You will report to the Regional Vice president\-Sales, India and work onsite in Gurgaon, India.


**Your Responsibilities**

This role would be primarily responsible for following:


**Drive execution of strategic priorities:** Own tracking and delivery of key BSR initiatives; ensure clear milestones, accountability and outcomes.


* **Governance \& IRC (schedule management):** Establish and run a regular operating rhythm (IRC, reviews, dashboards, and escalation forums) to maintain momentum across cross\-functional teams.
* **Cross\-functional orchestration:** Act as a central integrator across sales, BU, delivery, finance, HR, Marketing, GCCs and other global stakeholders to remove silos and accelerate decision\-making.
* **Executive decision support:** Summarise inputs into crisp insights, highlight risks/opportunities and prepare structured recommendations for MD review
* **Performance tracking and analytics:** Build visibility on initiative performance (KPIs, leading indicators), flag deviations early and lead corrective actions.
* **Special projects and transformation initiatives:** Lead high\-impact, time\-bound projects (e.g., operating model, productivity improvements, growth programmes).
* **Stakeholder management:** Interface with internal leaders and global teams to ensure agreement, communication.
* **Drive culture of accountability:** Reinforce outcome ownership, challenge slippages and institutionalise excellence.

**Critical qualities deemed essential.**

* Experience handling sensitive information following company policies and procedures and attention to data privacy requirements. upholding the decorum and status of the MDs office.
* Experience collaborating and communicating effectively with cross\-functional teams, senior leadership and executives.
* Knowledge of business and financial principles and their application to organisational goals.
* Collaborator with business teams/ functions and experienced at networking .
* Analyse complex situations, evaluate options, and make informed decisions that support our goals.
* Experience managing tasks and priorities while adapting to evolving our requirements.
* Proficiency in using relevant software and technology tools.

**Important deliverables/ success measures**

* Growth measured through execution of strategic projects.
* Follow programme management calendar.
* Impactful strategic briefings/ reports delivered.
* New c\-suite/ senior leaders relationships gained through influence.
* Incremental business brought because of RAs participation/ access/ influence in relevant forums.

**The Essentials \- You Will Have:**

* Bachelor's (Master's preferred) degree in Technology/ Engineering/ Business administration/ Political Science/ Public Relations/ Law.
* 10\+ Years of professional experience managing strategic projects/ Special projects and transformation projects
* Experience working in software/ technology companies at the leadership level.

**The Preferred \- You Might Also Have:**

* Experience in advocacy or public policy required.

**What We Offer:**

Our benefits package includes …


* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* Employee Assistance Program

* On\-demand digital course library for professional development

... and other local benefits!

**Job description:**

**Job Title: Analytical Chemist – HPLC, UV, Dissolution, Assay, RS, and Method Validation**  
**Company: KMS Healthcare Pvt. Ltd.**  
**Department: Analytical R\&D / Quality Control**   
**Experience: 0\-3 years in pharmaceutical analysis**

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking an experienced **Analytical Chemist** with expertise in **HPLC, UV\-Vis spectroscopy, dissolution testing, assay, related substances (RS), and method validation** as per **ICH guidelines**. The candidate will be responsible for conducting analytical testing, preparing protocols/reports, and ensuring compliance with regulatory standards.

**Key Responsibilities: 1\. Analytical Testing \& Instrumentation:**

* Perform routine and non\-routine analysis using **HPLC, UV\-Vis, dissolution apparatus**, and other lab instruments.
* Conduct **assay, related substances (RS), dissolution, and stability testing** as per pharmacopeial methods (USP/EP/BP/IP).
* Troubleshoot and maintain analytical instruments (HPLC, UV spectrophotometer, dissolution apparatus).

**2\. Method Validation \& Transfer:**

* Prepare and execute **method validation/verification protocols** (Accuracy, Precision, Linearity, Specificity, LOD/LOQ, Robustness) as per **ICH Q2(R1\)**.
* Support method transfer activities between labs or sites.

**3\. Documentation \& Compliance:**

* Prepare **analytical reports, validation protocols, and reports** in compliance with **GMP/GLP**.
* Review and ensure data integrity (ALCOA\+ principles).
* Follow **SOPs, pharmacopeial guidelines (USP/EP), and ICH requirements**.

**4\. Regulatory \& Audits:**

* Support regulatory submissions (ANDAs, DMFs) with analytical data.
* Participate in internal/external audits (FDA, WHO, MHRA).

**5\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration:**

* Work with QA, R\&D, and production teams for investigations (OOS/OOT, deviations).
* Train junior analysts on analytical techniques and compliance.

**Qualifications \& Skills:**

* **Education:** B.Sc/M.Sc in Chemistry and B.Pharm./M.Pharm./B.Tech\-Biotechnology in Pharmaceutical Sciences or Life Science.
* **Experience:** 0\-3 years in **pharmaceutical ADL/QC labs**,

with hands\-on experience in:

* **HPLC/UPLC** (method development/validation preferred).
* **UV\-Vis spectroscopy and dissolution testing (Apparatus I/II).**
* **Assay, RS, forced degradation studies.**
* **Regulatory Knowledge:** ICH, USFDA, GMP, GLP.
* **Soft Skills:** Detail\-orientated, problem\-solving, and teamwork.

**Preferred:**

* Experience in **oral solid dosages (tablets/capsules)**.
* Knowledge of **impurity profiling, stability studies (ICH Q1A).**

**Why Join Us?**

* Opportunity to work in a **GMP\-compliant lab** with advanced instrumentation.
* Career growth in analytical development/validation.
* Exposure to global regulatory standards.

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**


Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.


As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.  

**For everyone, everywhere.**


More about **our mission** and **what we offer**.

 **Job Description**  

Onboarding support

* Support the administrative process of onboarding new joiners, helping ensure the Wiser journey is as smooth as possible with everyone involved kept in the loop
* Coordinate adaptable onboarding plans in partnership with hiring Leads, and support future changes that align to Wise’s way of working
* Support the relocation process for new joiners, helping ensure logistics and documentation requirements are handled smoothly
* Participate with other members of our wider People team in facilitating new joiner engagement \& networking
* Support running local onboarding sessions, sharing relevant new joiner information for that first week (e.g. joiners, benefits, etc)


Wiser support

* Support the People team’s ticketing desk with a one\-team mentality by responding to queries in an efficient and customer\-centric way
* Provide first\-line guidance to Wisers on leave policies, supporting a strong end\-to\-end experience
* Support internal transfers and relocation requests, ensuring onboarding and offboarding actions are completed
* Support processing Workday actions in relation to the Wiser lifecycle
* Help ensure operational onboarding and offboarding steps are completed, working closely with Workplace, User Technology and People Services teams to keep processes running smoothly
* Maintain team content on Confluence, ensuring information to Wisers is transparent, convenient, easy to remember and updated, thinking globally as well as locally for process efficiency, alignment and speed
* Support the Payroll team with documentation and/or information needed to process changes (joiners, benefits, leavers, etc)
* Produce standard employment documentation (e.g. reference letters, contract changes, etc) with support and guidance from the team


Research, process enhancement \& documentation

* Conduct research and gather feedback from stakeholders (e.g. new joiners, hiring leads, People team) to identify friction points and improvement opportunities across the Wiser lifecycle
* Support process enhancement work by mapping current workflows, proposing improvements, and helping implement updates to improve clarity, speed and consistency
* Create and maintain clear documentation (SOPs, checklists, templates) for recurring processes and knowledge sharing
* Track and report basic operational metrics (e.g. ticket themes, onboarding volumes, turnaround times) to support continuous improvement


Innovation \+ automation

* Identify opportunities to streamline repetitive tasks through automation (e.g. templates, workflows, Workday/Confluence enablement, ticketing macros), partnering with the team to test and roll out improvements
* Support standardisation of forms, communication and trackers to reduce manual work and improve the Wiser experience
* Contribute ideas for improving tooling, self\-serve guidance and ways of working across the People operations journey

  

Note: This is a **12\-month fixed\-term contract** with the potential for extension or conversion into a permanent role based on individual performance, business needs, and headcount availability.

 **Qualifications** **Education \& Graduation**  

* **Graduation Year:** Recent graduates from the **2025** or **2026** batch.
* **Degree Backgrounds:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in (but not limited to):


Human Resources Management / Business Administration (BBA, MBA, BMS)  

Social Sciences / Psychology / Organisational Behaviour/ English Literature / History / Commerce / Information Technology (or related fields with a strong passion for People Operations and HR Tech)  

  

**Key Skills \& Attributes*** **Customer\-Centric and Problem\-solving Mindset:** Empathetic, approachable, and proactive communication skills to deliver a seamless experience for new joiners and existing employees
* **Process \& Tech Savvy:** Comfortable learning HR systems (like Workday), documentation tools (like Confluence), and ticketing systems; an interest in using basic automation, templates, or AI tools to streamline repetitive work is a huge plus.
* **Detail \& Organisation:** Strong organisational skills with keen attention to detail when handling employment contracts, payroll support data, and compliance documents.
* **Adaptability \& Collaboration:** Thrives in a fast\-paced, global environment with a strong "one\-team" collaborative spirit.

title: HRIS Lead
description:
Location: Noida, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.


Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.**Role Overview:** Thales is seeking an experienced **HRIS Lead** to join our dynamic team. This role sits within Tier 2 support, providing advanced troubleshooting and problem\-solving expertise for our Human Resources Information System (HRIS). You will collaborate closely with Tier 1 representatives to resolve initial queries and escalate complex issues to our Tier 3 (Subject matter Experts) for in\-depth solutions, ensuring seamless HR operations and superior system performance.


The role reports to HRIS Manager sitting at Noida location.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Technical Support:**
	+ Provide Workday (WD) Tier 2 support for Thales internal entities and HR functions to troubleshoot and resolve advanced technical issues and system defects reported by end users.
	+ Ensure Optimal performance and functioning of Workday HR modules by addressing complex inquiries, troubleshooting problems, and implementing system enhancements.
	+ Monitor and respond to end\-user requests regarding system complications or malfunctions.
* **System Maintenance:**
	+ Perform regular system audits, data validation, and maintain data integrity within Workday.
	+ Assist with mass data input during large changes, including – but not limited to – restructures, acquisitions, and annual compensation reviews.
	+ Support and maintain robust security protocols; manage WD user access and permissions, ensuring compliance with internal data privacy policies and regulatory standards.
	+ Monitoring data integrations, performing testing and documenting process and results.
* **Process Improvement:**
	+ Supports various implementation activities for all HRIS technologies including gathering requirements and needs; liaising with third party vendors and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to ensure configurations meet requirements and needs.
	+ Manage and oversee HRIS\-related projects and programs, including project planning, resource allocation, stakeholder communication, and milestone tracking to ensure successful delivery and adoption.
* **Payroll and Time Management System Support**
	+ Act as the HRIS point of contact for regional Payroll and Time management systems, coordinating with payroll team and external vendor to troubleshoot application issues and support resolution.
	+ Coordinate and support payroll system integrations with WD and other downstream applications, ensuring data accuracy and facilitating resolution of interface\-related issues in collaboration with HR functions and vendors.
	+ Perform data quality reviews, reconciliation activities and coordinating corrective actions related to payroll and time management system integrations with WD.

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum 5 \- 7 years of experience in Workday.
* Experience working in coordination with third party payroll vendors to support system interfaces with WD and production support.
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field of study with a minimum of 5\-8\+ years of relevant experience, or Master’s degree in a related field of study with 4\+ years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Must be able to think analytically and with a big\-picture perspective; anticipate downstream impacts to system changes.
* Must be highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities, in addition to possessing effective stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Workday certification in one or more modules (e.g., C\&B, reporting etc.).
* Experience within HRIS implementation or support.
* Exposure to payroll applications and their integrations with HR systems.
* Experience coordinating with third\-party vendors for production support and system enhancements

**Desired Skills:**

* Global exposure in managing HRIS functions and global stakeholder management.
* Exposure in engaging and conducting demo sessions for HRIS campaign rollouts to ensure smooth user adoption globally.


At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Manager-Solutions & BD
description:
HRO Solution Lead About the role
  
As an HRO Solution Lead , you will make an impact by designing innovative and scalable Human Resources Outsourcing (HRO) solutions that address client business needs and drive successful outsourcing engagements. You will be a valued member of the HRO Solutions team and work collaboratively with HR operations, technology, finance, legal, sales, and client stakeholders to develop compelling solutions that differentiate Cognizant in the marketplace. In this role, you will:
  
Lead the analysis of client requirements from RFPs, RFIs, and RFQs to identify business objectives, challenges, and solution opportunities.
  
Design end\-to\-end HRO solutions, including operating models, service delivery frameworks, transition approaches, technology enablement, and pricing strategies.
  
Partner with cross\-functional teams to develop comprehensive, high\-quality proposals and solution artifacts.
  
Develop and present solution blueprints, value propositions, and business cases that clearly articulate client value and competitive differentiation.
  
Support due diligence activities, client workshops, and oral presentations throughout the pursuit lifecycle while ensuring adherence to internal governance standards. Work model
  
We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring attendance at a client or Cognizant office based on project and business needs. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations. What you need to have to be considered
  
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
  
Experience in HR operations, HRO solutioning, HR consulting, or business process outsourcing environments.
  
Proven experience leading solution design and responding to RFPs, RFIs, and RFQs for large\-scale HR outsourcing engagements.
  
Strong understanding of hire\-to\-retire HR processes, service delivery models, and HR technology platforms such as Workday or SAP SuccessFactors.
  
Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment. These will help you stand out
  
MBA or relevant advanced degree.
  
Experience supporting global HR outsourcing engagements across multiple geographies.
  
Knowledge of commercial constructs, pricing methodologies, and business case development.
  
Familiarity with digital HR solutions, automation platforms, analytics, and AI\-enabled HR technologies.
  
Strong understanding of market trends, industry best practices, and emerging innovations within the HRO landscape.
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Manager, People Business Partner
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Manager, People Business Partner
Title: Manager People Business Partner (HRBP), Pune  

  

Job Overview:
  

  

This position has responsibility for facilitating People \& Capability (P\&C) (Human Resources) related activities within MasterCard, Pune. Responsibilities include implementation of P\&C initiatives, and core human resources activities. The Manager People Business Partner will act as a positive cultural change agent, consultant and business advisor in partnering with employees and managers to enable the execution of business strategies and initiatives. The individual in this role will need to work in close collaboration with assigned Business Units and Regional colleagues to execute on initiatives.
  

  

Major Accountabilities:
  

The individual in this role will execute on strategic initiatives designed to enhance P\&C effectiveness and delivery. This individual will be responsible for managing and performing a wide range of P\&C activities for the groups that s/he supports. These activities include, but are not limited to:  

* Manage the day\-to\-day aspects of one or more complex projects; partners with key stakeholders across Business Unit and MasterCard at large to ensure the timely coordination and execution of plans and activities
* Participate in the Talent Acquisition process for the function as appropriate
* Coach employees and managers on a wide range of issues
* Facilitate job evaluation and compensation assessment as needed
* Partner with Business Unit executives and Finance to ensure the accuracy and integrity of the budget and headcount planning and tracking process
* Participate in the talent review process including leadership development and succession planning, skills assessment and organization design
* Participate in the facilitation of the Performance Management process, including the administration of the year\-end compensation process, goal setting and ratings calibration
* Process involuntary terminations as needed and prepare paperwork for legal review; manage pre and post termination issues and guide Manager through process
* Participate in Employee Relations activities in partnership with the SR PBP

  

Experience and Education:  

* Demonstrated People Business Partner (HRBP) experience
* Bachelor’s degree required, advanced degree and/or certification in HR preferred
* Core knowledge of HR principles, theories and concepts
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and initiatives exercising sound judgment, solutions orientation and flexibility
* Must demonstrate the ability to work cross functionally and across multiple geographies
* Must have good influencing skills
* Must have strong analytical, presentation, verbal and written communications skills
* AI fluency preferred
* Previous experience managing HR initiatives for innovation and technology functions/teams preferred

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Lead Specialist - GHRSS PMO
description:
**Introduction**  


Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.
  

**Overview**  

* The Project Manager plays a pivotal role in the design, implementation, governance, and execution of strategic HR programs and transformation initiatives across Global HR Shared Services and the broader HR organization.
* This role collaborates closely with HR leaders, onshore stakeholders, cross\-functional teams, and offshore delivery resources to establish project and portfolio management standards, ensure execution excellence, and deliver transformative HR initiatives aligned with organizational goals.
* The incumbent will lead efforts in integrated planning, governance reporting, dependency management, risk mitigation, stakeholder alignment, and continuous improvement. Additionally, this role will support the development and implementation of future\-state HR operating models, processes, technologies, and service delivery capabilities to drive organizational success.

  


  

**How you'll make an impact** **Responsibilities:**

 **Project Management \& Execution**

* Develop comprehensive project plans, including objectives, scope, deliverables, timelines, and resource requirements for HR initiatives.
* Identify and manage project risks, implementing mitigation strategies to ensure successful outcomes.
* Lead project teams, assign tasks, provide guidance, and ensure deliverables meet quality standards and comply with HR best practices and legal regulations.
* Oversee change management initiatives, ensuring smooth transitions for employees impacted by HR projects.
* Maintain accurate project documentation, including plans, progress reports, and post\-implementation reviews.

**HR Transformation \& Strategic Initiatives**

* Lead and support HR transformation initiatives across the global HR function, inclusive of Talent Management, Learning \& Development, Performance Management and HR Operations sub\-functions.
* Partner with onshore HR stakeholders to assess current\-state processes and design future\-state operating models, governance structures, and service delivery approaches.
* Drive the implementation of enterprise\-wide HR transformation programs, ensuring alignment with strategic business objectives.
* Contribute to organizational change management and adoption efforts for transformation initiatives.

**Portfolio \& Program Management**

* Establish and manage integrated project plans, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and critical paths across multiple initiatives.
* Monitor portfolio health, project performance, resource allocation, and risk/issue resolution.
* Facilitate status reviews and prepare project dashboards, KPIs, and project health metrics to support informed decision\-making.

**Stakeholder \& Executive Engagement**

* Collaborate with senior HR leaders and cross\-functional stakeholders to define project objectives, scope, outcomes, and success measures.
* Build strong relationships across a global, matrixed organization, driving alignment among diverse stakeholder groups.
* Facilitate workshops, leadership discussions, and project reviews to support decision\-making and resolve issues.
* Communicate project progress, risks, and strategic insights to stakeholders at all organizational levels.
* Consult and coach other HR teams / stakeholders on project management methodologies and practices.

**PMO Governance \& Continuous Improvement**

* Design and enhance HR PMO methodologies, standards, templates, tools, and governance processes.
* Drive consistency in project management practices across HR initiatives and teams.
* Implement best practices for project planning, reporting, risk management, change management, and benefits realization.
* Identify and execute opportunities to improve operational efficiency, project delivery, and stakeholder experience.

**Global Collaboration \& Team Leadership**

* Collaborate with global teams across regions, functions, and time zones to ensure successful delivery of strategic initiatives.
* Partner with offshore project management and delivery teams to achieve objectives and maintain quality standards.
* Provide coaching, guidance, and leadership to team members and workstream participants to foster collaboration and high performance.

  


  

**About you** **Qualifications:**

  

Education: Bachelor/ Master’s degree in business management, Human Resources, or a related field is required.


Licenses/Certificates:

* Project Management
* Lean/Six Sigma (preferred)

 **Work Experience:*** 10–12 years of progressive experience in project management, program management, PMO leadership, management consulting, or HR transformation within HR operations or shared services environments.
* Proven track record of successfully managing large\-scale, cross\-functional programs and multiple concurrent initiatives with measurable outcomes.
* Hands\-on experience in HR transformation projects, including HR system implementation/enhancements, operating model redesign, process optimization, and shared services transitions.
* Prior experience in global, matrixed organizations with a demonstrated ability to navigate complex structures and collaborate across diverse teams and geographies.

**Skills and Competencies:**

 **Core Project Management Skills**

* Proven experience in project and program management, with a track record of delivering results in fast\-paced environments.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage competing deadlines.
* Proficiency in project management tools and openness to adopting low\-code/no\-code platforms and AI\-driven solutions.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively, with a focus on achieving project goals.

 **Leadership \& Portfolio Management**

* Expertise in portfolio governance, dependency management, and risk/issue management.
* Skilled in resource planning, prioritization, and aligning initiatives with organizational objectives.
* Strong facilitation and stakeholder alignment capabilities, with the ability to influence without direct authority.

**HR \& Business Acumen**

* Comprehensive understanding of HR operating models, service delivery, and key HR functions (e.g., Talent Management, Learning \& Development, Employee Experience).
* Knowledge of organizational effectiveness, change management, and process improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma).

**Technology \& Analytical Skills**

* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365 tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint).
* Experience with project portfolio management tools (e.g., MS Planner, Project Place) and process mapping tools (e.g., Visio, Lucid).
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with expertise in KPI development and performance measurement.

  


  

**Additional Information**  

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well\-being
* Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
* A collaborative, people\-first culture with accessible leadership
* The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact

**At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace.** If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles.*Gallagher is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

title: Controls Engineering - Training Manager
description:
**Job Requirements**  

At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.

 **Position Overview**


We are seeking a strategic and technical **Training Manager** to lead our Controls Engineering Learning \& Development division. This role is designed for a veteran leader with a deep background in **Gas/Steam Turbine Systems** and **Controls Software Engineering**.


Unlike a traditional trainer, you will be the architect of our engineering competency roadmap. You will bridge the gap between complex technical requirements—ranging from **HMI UI/UX** to **Cyber Security** and **High\-Fidelity Simulations**—and organizational scaling. Your leadership will directly ensure that our engineering pipeline is robust, high\-performing, and aligned with our $20M\+ project portfolio.

 **Key Managerial \& Strategic Responsibilities**

* **Strategic L\&D Roadmap:** Design and execute an end\-to\-end training strategy for the Controls division, focusing on **New Product Introduction (NPI)**, **Sustenance**, and **Obsolescence Engineering**.
* **Operational Governance:** Oversee the delivery of 40\+ training programs annually, ensuring **95% on\-time completion** and a **90% certification success rate**.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Act as the primary liaison between Engineering, Manufacturing, and HR to align training outcomes with project delivery milestones and commissioning support.
* **Performance Analytics:** Implement data\-driven metrics to track **Post\-Training Performance Improvement (target: 85%)** and trainee satisfaction (NPS).
* **Innovation Leadership:** Drive the adoption of **AI, VR simulations, and Cloud\-based Operator Training Simulators (OTS)** to modernize the learning experience.
* **Team Mentorship:** Lead and develop a team of Training Engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.

 **Core Technical Domain Oversight**

* **Controls Software:** Oversee training in Software Development, Validation/Testing, and Process Improvements.
* **UI/UX \& HMI:** Standardize mastery in **Activepoint HMI**, Legacy Screens, and **Alarm Rationalization**.
* **Hardware Engineering:** Ensure competency in **Panel Design, Manufacturing Drawings, BoM generation**, and Heat/Power calculations.
* **Network \& Cyber Security:** Develop curricula for **Network Architecture** and **Cyber Risk Assessment** implementation.
* **Modelling \& Simulation:** Lead the strategy for **Combined Cycle Plant simulations** and issue debugging training.

  

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.

  

We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference\-makers in our workplace.

 **Work Experience**  

* **Education:** B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech in related field.
* **Experience:** 10–15 years of proven experience in **Gas/Steam Turbine Controls** or **Industrial Automation**, with at least **5 years in a leadership/managerial role**.
* **Technical Proficiency:**
	+ Expertise in **Controls Software Engineering** and HMI design concepts.
	+ Strong understanding of **Network Architecture** and Third\-Party interfacing.
	+ Proficiency in **MATLAB/Simulink** or equivalent High\-Fidelity modeling tools.
* **Soft Skills:** Exceptional communication, the ability to influence senior management, and a passion for mentoring mid\-level talent to reduce attrition.

 **Personal Attributes**

* **Change Agent:** Ability to adapt training methodologies to solve emerging technical challenges.
* **Strategic Thinker:** Focused on long\-term talent sustainability rather than just short\-term fixes.

  

**Benefits**  

Best in industry complied with regional policies.

Our particular strength lies in our global network, which is constantly being maintained and expanded. As part of Rhenus Air \& Ocean you can, therefore, expect to find a whole host of exciting tasks all over the world, a wide range of opportunities for personal development, and the chance to take on responsibility in an international working environment.


**Welcome to Rhenus**
---------------------

We are a global powerhouse on a mission to be pioneers in everything we do. United, we make an impact and dare to redefine what's possible. Ready to unlock untapped potential. We are on the fast track. At Rhenus, we thrive on collaboration. Every voice is heard, and every idea is valued. We stand as one global team. Where everyone contributes to our success. Together, we shape the future of logistics and beyond. Empowered by you.


**Recruitment Process**
-----------------------


#### **Online application**


Your documents will reach us quickly and directly via our online application form; depending on the position, a cover letter may be required. In any case, we are eager to see your CV and references – for us, the best way to make a good first impression.


#### **Application screening**


Our HR team and the responsible department will take a close look at your application as soon as possible. We will do our best to give you feedback within two weeks. With your agreement, we would also be happy to forward the documents to other business units if the selected position does not work out.


#### **Selection Process**


Depending on the position, there are various ways of finding out if we are a good match for each other. In most cases, we rely on a personal interview, on a eye level of course. Online tests, assessment centres or work on a trial basis may also be possible. In the end, the best decision is taken for both sides.

title: Director, Talent Partner
description:
We are looking for a **Director, Talent Partner – India** to join our Global Talent team. Reporting to the **Senior Director, Global Talent** and serving on the India Leadership Team, you will be the senior Talent Partner supporting the India organization.



You will lead and develop the India\-based members of the Global Talent team, including Talent Partners, Talent Specialists, and Recruiting, with responsibility for their day\-to\-day priorities and delivery. Together, the team supports talent acquisition, manager enablement, performance management, succession planning, leadership development, and employee engagement.



Working closely with the Senior Director, Global Talent, U.S.\-based leaders, and global Centers of Excellence, you will translate Model N’s global Talent strategy into effective execution in India and bring India insights into broader company discussions. This is a highly collaborative leadership role requiring a strong on\-site presence, sound judgment, and an enterprise mindset.


### **Job Responsibilities**

* Serve as the senior Talent Partner and trusted advisor to the India Leadership Team, connecting India’s business and talent priorities to Model N’s broader company strategy.
* Lead and develop the India\-based members of the Global Talent team, providing clear day\-to\-day direction, accountability, coaching, and support.
* Partner with the Senior Director, Global Talent to establish India priorities and execute Model N’s global Talent strategy and operating model.
* Advise and coach leaders on organizational design, workforce planning, leadership development, succession, organizational effectiveness, growth, and change.
* Lead India’s delivery of global talent programs, including performance management, talent reviews, manager enablement, employee engagement, and talent acquisition.
* Use talent insights and business data to strengthen organizational performance, identify risks, and inform broader Talent priorities.
* Partner across the global Talent and People organizations to deliver a consistent, scalable, and outstanding employee experience.
* Maintain close alignment with the Senior Director, Global Talent on priorities, resources, decisions, and emerging organizational needs.

**What Success Looks Like**


**In Your First 90 Days**


* Build strong relationships with the Senior Director, Global Talent, India business leaders, and key global partners.
* Develop a clear understanding of the business, India talent priorities, and the Global Talent strategy and operating model.
* Establish effective working rhythms and shared priorities with the Senior Director, Global Talent.
* Assess the India\-based team, current programs, and opportunities to strengthen execution and global alignment.
* Establish yourself as a collaborative advisor, trusted people leader, and connector between India and the global organization.

**Over Your First 6–12 Months**


* Manage and continue to strengthen a high\-performing India\-based team with clear accountability and strong integration across Global Talent.
* Strengthen leadership and manager capability across the India organization.
* Improve talent outcomes through effective delivery of performance management, succession planning, manager enablement, and other global programs.
* Ensure India talent priorities and practices remain aligned with Model N’s enterprise strategy and global operating model.
* Bring meaningful India insights and scalable ideas into global Talent discussions.
* Become a trusted member of the India Leadership Team and a valued partner across the Global Talent organization.

**How You Will Grow and Make an Impact**



At Model N, our competency model helps define growth and success. The most important competencies for this role are:


* **People Leadership:** Develop talent, set clear expectations, and strengthen the performance of the India\-based team.
* **Collaborative Leadership:** Build shared ownership and deliver results through strong global and cross\-functional partnerships.
* **Problem\-Solving Leadership:** Address complex organizational challenges that improve business performance.
* **Thought Leadership:** Bring relevant India insights and a strong Talent perspective to broader organizational discussions.
* **Operational Leadership:** Deliver consistent, scalable Talent solutions that produce measurable outcomes.
* **AI Leadership:** Use AI thoughtfully to improve Talent processes and help teams adopt new ways of working.

### **Job Qualification**


* 12\+ years of experience in **Talent Partner, HR Business Partner, talent acquisition, or broader People leadership roles.**
* Demonstrated success managing and developing teams with multiple direct reports.
* Experience leading or managing recruiting operations as part of an integrated Talent function.
* Experience partnering with senior leaders in a consultative, globally matrixed environment.
* Experience working for a U.S.\-headquartered company or another global organization, including close partnership with U.S.\-based leaders.
* Strong expertise in o**rganizational effectiveness, workforce planning, performance management, succession planning, leadership development, and manager enablement.**
* Demonstrated ability to translate enterprise strategies and programs into effective local execution.
* Strong communication, collaboration, influencing, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to balance India business needs with global standards and enterprise priorities.
* Experience using talent data and workforce insights to guide business decisions.
* Strong knowledge of India employment practices and the India talent market.
* Demonstrated experience using generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, Gemini) to improve productivity, decision‑making, or problem solving in a professional or personal context.
* Must reside in Hyderabad or commit to relocating within 90 days of employment.

**Preferred**


* Experience in SaaS, technology, or another high\-growth global organization.
* Experience supporting India within a globally integrated Talent or People operating model.
* Experience with Workday and modern HR technologies.
**About Model N**Model N is the leader in revenue optimization and compliance for pharmaceutical, medtech and high\-tech innovators. For more than 25 years, we have helped customers maximize revenue, streamline operations, and maintain compliance through cloud\-based software, value\-add services, and data\-driven insights. With a focus on innovation and customer success, Model N empowers life sciences and high\-tech manufacturers to bring life\-changing products to the world more efficiently and profitably. Model N is trusted by over 150 of the world’s leading companies across more than 120 countries. For more information, visit www.modeln.com.  



We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Sr. Product Design Manager – HRIS | India Design Site Lead
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.85B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

 **About the role**


At Rippling, Design is central to our mission to free smart people to tackle hard problems. We build products that automate the operational complexity of running a business—from HR and payroll to IT and finance—so our customers can focus on what matters most. In a world of fragmented, outdated systems, we’re creating a modern, unified platform where thoughtful design turns complexity into clarity and confidence.

  

As the Senior Product Design Manager for HRIS and India Site Lead, you will lead a team of \~6 designers responsible for Rippling's HCM and HRIS products, while serving as the site lead for the broader India design organization, supporting an additional \~5 designers across Payroll, Finance, and Platform. You'll play a key role in growing design talent, strengthening team culture, and partnering with cross\-functional leaders to raise the quality and impact of the organization.

  

Your team owns products at the heart of how companies manage their workforce, from core employee records to onboarding, compliance, and global workforce operations. You'll lead the evolution of these experiences while helping define Rippling's AI\-first future, designing intelligent workflows and agentic experiences that automate HR work at scale.


Success in this role requires a leader who can navigate highly complex product domains, think in systems, and balance long\-term platform strategy with exceptional product execution. You'll empower your team to solve challenging customer problems, raise the bar for design craft, and shape experiences that millions of employees and HR administrators rely on every day.

* Lead and grow a team of product designers across the HCM product suite, driving high\-impact work across HR, Talent, Benefits, and Workforce Management.
* Design and deliver complex, business\-critical experiences that are intuitive, scalable, and trustworthy across global and regulatory contexts.
* Define and drive AI\-native experiences that radically simplify administrator and employee workflows—leveraging automation, intelligent defaults, and agentic systems to reduce operational overhead.
* Set a high bar for craft, quality, and execution—mentoring designers, providing actionable feedback, and creating an environment where designers do the best work of their careers.
* Drive end\-to\-end product thinking—from early problem definition and research through execution and iteration—across both 01 initiatives and mature product areas.
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and cross\-functional stakeholders to define product strategy, prioritize initiatives, and deliver against ambitious roadmaps.
* Establish and reinforce systems thinking across the team—creating patterns and frameworks that scale across products and ensure consistency across Rippling’s platform.
* Translate complex operational, compliance, and workforce challenges into simple, elegant user experiences for both administrators and employees.
* Champion a deep understanding of customers, especially in high\-complexity domains like global HR, compliance, and hourly workforce management.
* Contribute to and evolve Rippling’s design system, ensuring consistency and quality across surfaces while enabling teams to move quickly.
* Drive alignment across teams working on interdependent systems, ensuring cohesive experiences across HRIS, Time, and the broader Rippling platform.
* Serve as the India Site Lead for Design, fostering a vibrant local office culture, driving team collaboration, and providing site\-wide operational leadership.

**What you will need**

* 10\+ years of professional product design experience, with 5\+ years leading and managing design teams.
* Proven track record of delivering high\-impact, customer\-facing products in complex domains such as HCM/HRIS, fintech, enterprise software, or workforce management.
* Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity and large problem spaces, turning complex systems into intuitive, user\-friendly experiences.
* Strong systems thinking, with experience designing across interconnected products or platforms and creating scalable patterns and frameworks.
* Experience defining and shipping AI\-native or automation\-driven product experiences, including intelligent workflows, decision support, or agentic systems that reduce user effort.
* Experience owning and delivering end\-to\-end product design—from strategy and roadmap definition through execution and QA.
* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and grow designers across different levels of experience, raising the overall quality bar of the team.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross\-functional partners and drive alignment across teams.
* Strong product sense and judgment, with the ability to balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints.
* A deep customer focus, with experience translating real\-world workflows (e.g., HR operations, scheduling, compliance) into effective product experiences.
* A bias toward action and ownership—you thrive in fast\-paced environments and are comfortable driving clarity and direction in evolving problem spaces.
* Strong leadership presence with the ability to manage site operations and cultivate a high\-performing design community in the India office.

*If you don't necessarily meet all of these requirements, we still encourage you to apply. Skills transfer in unexpected ways, and diverse perspectives often lead to the most innovative solutions.*

title: HR Partner, Corporate HR Partner Organization, HR Partner
description:
**Description**
 At Amazon, HR Partners (HRP) provide high\-judgment HR support to managers across levels at scale, enabling them to become force multipliers for customer impact and positive employee experience. They demonstrate advanced knowledge of HR policies, processes, and tools, acting as trusted consultants to managers and senior managers. HRPs work backwards from the voice of the manager to deliver personalized experiences and drive large\-scale initiatives using technology and simplified processes that match the speed and agility of our business. They operate independently as subject matter experts with deep knowledge of regional programs and policies, collaborating extensively with PXT teams including HR Business Partners, Employee Relations, Legal, and others to provide integrated people solutions. As established practitioners, they mentor junior team members and shape best practices across the region.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Managers and senior managers collaborate with Senior HR Partners to support sensitive and often complex employee issues including disciplinary, performance improvement and grievance processes. The Sr. HRP acts as an influential partner in helping managers with talent and performance management processes, people development, HR policies and implementation of organizational changes at the country or regional level. Thanks to their front\-line visibility across businesses, Sr. HRPs are in a position to spot trends, identify emerging needs and address them in collaboration with the appropriate business and HR stakeholders. Sr. HRPs are also expected to partner on complex global and regional strategic priorities and process improvement initiatives. As a subject matter expert, Sr. HRPs mentor and guide junior team members.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**
* Performance Management: Partner with managers on complex and nuanced performance management cases including performance improvement plans and assessments. Guide managers in implementing performance management processes and tools effectively. Partner with managers to ensure bias\-free evaluations and effective coaching approaches across teams. Analyze performance data to identify trends, share insights, and develop solutions for systemic issues.
* Employee Relations: Handle complex and nuanced employee relations cases and investigations following established processes and policies. Conduct thorough and impartial investigations, support grievance processes, and lead informal discussions or mediation. Provide guidance to managers on sophisticated ER matters including policy violations and workplace concerns across countries. Partner with Legal and Employee Relations teams to resolve sensitive cases while ensuring compliance and risk mitigation. Analyze investigation findings, prepare recommendations, and identify trends to prevent future risks.
* HR General: Act as stewards of the employee experience and Amazon’s culture. Act as subject matter expert for people tools, processes, programs or projects. Design and deliver Manager Education initiatives to further drive collective education and manager effectiveness. Analyze data and observations across the organization, highlighting trends and recommending/driving solutions, as appropriate.
* Change Management: Drive implementation of employee programs and lead improvements in manager experience. Partner with HR Business Partners and central teams on complex change initiatives across countries. Use data and insights to advocate for and influence process improvements. Design and execute change management strategies to ensure effective adoption across diverse employee groups.
* Process Improvement: Drive complex strategic priorities and process improvement initiatives across India. Partner with global HRP team, other HR teams and CoEs to drive global and regional HRP strategic projects.


 This role is performed through an innovative customer relationship Management tool that enables this team to be uniquely positioned to identify trending issues and themes through data and inform consequent decisions and initiatives.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field, or 5\+ years of human resources experience and Bachelor's degree
* Experience delivering results by partnering with and influencing others
* Experience coaching and mentoring at the management level
* Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment
* Experience in computer skills, including proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Experience working effectively across cross\-functional teams and partnering well with people at all levels within an organization
* Business and HR acumen, including problem solving skills, critical thinking, and self\-initiative


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in Human Resources or related field with about 6\-10 years’ work experience. Proven track record of accomplishments in a dynamic environment, which is fast paced and customer driven. Proven ability to prioritize, meet deadlines and make the best use of available resources. Project management and the ability to deliver, with a proven track record of influencing through data\-driven recommendations. Coaching and consulting skills; Ability to work with and influence multiple stakeholders. Experience in dealing with contingent workforce will be an advantage. Presentation skills and knowledge of employment laws.

Job Description – Analyst, HRIS


News Corp is a global, diversified media and information services company focused on creating and distributing authoritative and engaging content and other products and services. The company comprises businesses across a range of media, including digital real estate services, subscription video services in Australia, news and information services and book publishing. Headquartered in New York, News Corp operates primarily in the United States, Australia, and the United Kingdom, and its content and other products and services are distributed and consumed worldwide.


We at Bangalore are News Corp’s premier Development Center. We provide global technology and information services that connect people to the news they need. We are an essential part of News Corp’s global technology strategy. We work directly with News Corp’s global brands to offer a range of technology services, including Mobile Development, Web Solutions, Analytical Services, IT Infrastructure Support, and Cyber Security Operations.


We are seeking an HRIS Analyst with 3\-5 years of experience to join our team at News Corporation Bangalore location. As an HRIS Analyst, you will be responsible for providing comprehensive support for the seamless functioning of our Workday systems and processes globally.


Key Responsibilities:


* Manage day\-to\-day support and maintenance of Workday operations across all global Business Units.
* Provide functional and techno\-functional support to News Corp's HROPs teams by analyzing and resolving queries raised on different functional areas such as: Core HCM, Recruiting, Onboarding, Offboarding, Compensation, Time Tracking, Leaves and Absence and Performance Management.
* Ensure data quality, integrity, and operational efficiency of HR systems in a fast\-paced, matrixed organization.
* Perform quantitative and qualitative analysis of support and work with HROPs and product owners to bring down the operational support and improve user experience.
* Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations, SOX requirements, and internal controls where applicable.
* Support Workday Integration, EIB inbound processes, analyzing conditions and eligibility rules, and maintaining fundamental knowledge of security groups and roles.
* Perform root cause analysis on HRIS support issues and proactively identify, document, and report configuration changes or enhancement requirements to improve system functionality and user experience.
* Participate in system testing, release activities, and support bi\-annual Workday upgrades where applicable.
* Create and maintain documentation including SOPs, best practices, requirement documents, training material, and status reports.
* Follow SDLC and Agile methodologies while supporting projects and operational activities.
* Participate in process improvement initiatives and recommend automation opportunities to enhance operational efficiency.
* Manage and resolve HRIS support tickets through ServiceNow or other ticketing platforms.
* Flexibility to work in different shift hours as required.

Required Skills \& Qualifications:


* Minimum of 3\+ years of experience in global HRIS, with a focus on support and maintenance.
* A bachelor’s degree in business administration, Management, or Human Resources
* Hands\-on experience in Workday modules, including HCM, Absence Management, Time Tracking, Performance Management, Reporting, Compensation Management, and Recruiting.
* Experience with Workday EIBs, integrations, reporting, and security concepts.
* Basic understanding of APIs, XML/XSLT, or Workday Studio is an added advantage.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem\-solving, and root cause analysis skills.
* Experience in gathering, documenting, and reporting Workday configuration and enhancement requirements based on operational support analysis and business needs.
* Exceptional communication skills and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to articulate technical issues and solutions to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong documentation, reporting, and organizational skills.
* Strong attention to detail and a collaborative team player with strategic and operational acumen.
* Demonstrating strong teamwork skills in a rapidly expanding organization.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and uphold high ethical standards.
* Proficiency in process re\-engineering, problem\-solving, and root cause analysis.
* Knowledge of Agile and SDLC methodologies preferred.
* Experience with ServiceNow ticketing and workflow management is preferred.
* Knowledge of Excel functions (VLOOKUP, charts, data validation).

**Equal Opportunity Employer**


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other protected characteristic.


**Reasonable Accommodation**


We are committed to providing reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application and/or interview process. If you need assistance or accommodation in completing your application or participating in an interview due to a disability, email us at humanresources@newscorp.com . Please put "Reasonable Accommodation" in the subject line and provide a brief description of the type of assistance you need. This inbox will not be monitored for application status updates.


Please refer to the privacy notice at the bottom of this page for submitting any data access, deletion, or other data subject rights requests, where permitted under your local laws and regulations.


This job is posted with NTS Technology Services Pvt. Ltd.


News Corp (Nasdaq: NWS, NWSA; ASX: NWS, NWSLV) is a global, diversified media and information services company focused on creating and distributing authoritative and engaging content and other products and services. The company comprises businesses across a range of media, including: information services and news, digital real estate services and book publishing. Headquartered in New York, News Corp operates primarily in the United States, Australia and the United Kingdom, and its content and other products and services are distributed and consumed worldwide. More information is available at: http://newscorp.com.

title: Oracle HCM Functional-Talent Management and Core HR
description:
Huron is a global consultancy that collaborates with clients to drive strategic growth, ignite innovation and navigate constant change. Through a combination of strategy, expertise and creativity, we help clients accelerate operational, digital and cultural transformation, enabling the change they need to own their future.  

  

Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.


Looking for an experienced Oracle Cloud HCM Consultant for implementation, configuration, and support of Oracle Cloud HCM modules, This role requires a deep understanding of HR processes and the ability to translate business requirements into effective system solutions. Lead and participate in the full lifecycle implementation of Oracle Cloud HCM.  

Configure the Oracle Cloud Applications to meet business requirements and document the configurations. Work closely with HR teams and other stakeholders to understand their needs and provide solutions.  

  

Primary Modules\- Core HR and Talent Management with hands\-on experience in Redwood UI implementation* Lead and support Redwood UI adoption across Core HR and Talent Management modules.
* Drive requirement gathering, fit–gap analysis, solution design, and module configuration.
* Configure and support Core HR, Absence Management, Benefits, Payroll, OTL, and Talent Management modules based on business requirements.
* Participate in functional testing, UAT support, and deployment activities, ensuring smooth implementation.
* Act as a subject matter expert for Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM, guiding clients through design, configuration, and implementation phases.
* Troubleshoot and resolve functional issues across HCM modules.
* Collaborate with technical teams on reports, integrations, data conversions, workflows, security, and extensions.
* Validate technical components and support resolution of implementation issues.
* Support clients during all testing phases and post‑deployment stabilization.
* Develop end‑user documentation and training materials for Fusion HCM solutions.
* Conduct client demos and workshops, tailoring sessions to showcase value and address client needs.
* Lead and contribute to RFP responses, working closely with sales and technical teams to deliver high‑quality proposals.
* Oversee and manage offshore deliverables, ensuring quality, timelines, and alignment with project goals.
* Lead discussions and demos with onshore teams and clients, ensuring alignment and clarity.
* Ensure high client satisfaction through effective collaboration across global teams.
* Strong functional expertise in Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM, particularly Global HR and Talent Management.
* Hands‑on experience with Redwood UI.
* Experience in workflows, security configurations, and OTBI reporting.
* Proven experience working on Oracle HCM Cloud implementations in global, multi‑cultural environments.
* Strong presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Familiarity with Agile / Iterative delivery methodologies.
* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA (HRMS) preferred.
* Immediate joiners up to the Senior Associate level are preferred.

description:
We are looking for an Associate STEM Content Analyst to join our GENESEQ process in **Chennai**. This is an amazing opportunity to work on GENESEQ process in IPG.  **About You**

* Must be a Masters degree grad in Genetics, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Bioinformatics, Microbiology, Biotechnology and equivalent skill set / B.Tech Biotechnology.
* Can be a fresher or candidate with around 1 year experience in working on patents, patent indexing with basic patent knowledge.
* If experienced, must have at least a year’s experience in patent indexing, disease indexing, abstract writing

The team will also create individual records for mutated sequences and for claimed SEQ ID fragments where the whole sequence has not been claimed.

**Nomura Overview:**


Nomura is a global financial services group with an integrated network spanning approximately 30 countries and regions. Nomura Services, India supports the group’s global businesses. With world\-class capabilities in trading support, research, information technology, financial control, operations, risk management and legal support, the firm plays a key role in facilitating the group’s global operations.  

At Nomura, creating an inclusive workplace is a priority. Our approach to inclusion encompasses a variety of initiatives, including sensitization campaigns, implementing conducive policies \& programs, providing infrastructure support and engaging in community events. Over time, we have made meaningful progress in these areas, and this commitment has been well\-recognized across the industry. We are proud recipients of the prestigious Top 10 Employers award by the India Workplace Equality Index (IWEI), IWEI Gold Employer of Choice awards, India CSR Leadership Award 2024 for Holistic Village Development Program and the YUVA Unstoppable Changemaker Awards.

* We offer a comprehensive range of wellbeing services which allows employees to get access to the assistance they need at any point in their wellbeing journey.
* Our bespoke benefits support employees and their family’s holistic wellbeing and are inclusive of diverse identities and family structures.

**Position Specifications:**
As Cash DVP credit analyst, you will be responsible for managing cash portfolio across sectors. In this role you will be responsible for managing all aspects of the portfolio, including assign Ratings, Limits, and exposure monitoring, monitoring early warning indicators for Cash DVP. In addition, you will support the build out of specialized data analytics and portfolio tools and actively participate in the risk monitoring of the portfolio. The position requires you to frequently interact with Clients, Traders, Operations, Legal and other teams in Risk Management, and where necessary escalate credit concerns to senior management.

Analyst  

  

**Functional Title**  

Analyst/Sr. Analyst

Fresher/1\-3 Years

CA Fresher/Master’s degree in finance from top institutes
  

**Role \& Responsibilities:**
The position is for DVP Client Review Team. This is highly visible global role, which involves working across functions and managing the cash DVP client portfolio across sectors and geographies.  

Responsibilities include ensuring the process is effective, stepping in to resolve conflict, escalating issues promptly, presenting at global committees, automating tasks and project management.  

The DVP team has global coverage across all sectors and regions, and is centralised in Powai. The team works closely with Credit Officers in CRM, as well as other divisions including Front Office, Middle Office, Operations, IT.  

Specifically, the DVP team has following responsibilities:
* Assign credit ratings to obligors actively trading on a Delivery v/s Payment (DVP) basis, using internal quantitative models.
* Reaffirm the ratings on an annual/semi\-annual basis for a portfolio of counterparties from across sectors, including Investment Advisors, Funds, Banks, Insurance Companies, Brokers, and Corporates.
* Monitor the performance of Counterparties, market developments, and closely track developments related to Counterparty, industry, regulations, etc. and take appropriate action as necessary.
* Liaise with Front Office / Credit Officers / Middle Office /Operations to correct Data Quality issues.
* Produce weekly Management Information
* Work on adhoc projects required by Front office/Credit Officers of different regions and other global projects for e.g. the development \& maintenance of scorecards, process enhancements, automation etc.
* Build data processes and implement models in Python/ Alteryx to minimize manual effort and enable analysts to effectively and efficiently manage their portfolios.
* Contribute to the firm’s Risk Change agenda and participate in regulatory and audit assessments.
  

**Requirements:**  

  

**Mandatory**  

* CA Fresher/PGDM/MBA (Finance)/1\-3 years of prior experience in Credit Risk Analysis or Credit Reporting or part of techno functional roles in the credit risk domain.
* Strong analytical skills, including data analysis and technological skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, ability to present at Committees and lead Discussion Forums.
* Delivery focussed with the ability to work well under pressure and meet deadlines under compressed timescales.
* Attention to detail, ability to understand the big picture and act accordingly.
* The ability to be a “self\-starter”, working without supervision and managing multiple stakeholder expectations.
* Strong coding skills in Python, SQL, VBA, Alteryx, Power BI, with hands\-on experience in self\-driving the initiatives using these tools
