title: Data Science Specialist
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 The Data Science Specialist will develop and implement Artificial Intelligence based solutions across various disciplines in GE Aerospace. In this role, the candidate will contribute to the development and deployment of modern machine learning, artificial intelligence, statistical methods, operations research, semantic analysis etc. for finding structure in large data sets. The candidate will be responsible for executing data science projects under limited guidance from senior members to deliver business outcomes. This role requires a good technical background, strong problem\-solving skills, and the ability to work collaboratively with stakeholders from different functional and business teams.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Site Overview
   

  

 Established in 2000, the John F. Welch Technology Center (JFWTC) in Bengaluru is our multidisciplinary research and engineering center. Engineers and scientists at JFWTC have contributed to hundreds of aviation patents, pioneering breakthroughs in engine technologies, advanced materials, and additive manufacturing.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

* Understand business problems and implement Data Science solutions.
* Design, develop, and implement machine learning and artificial intelligence models and algorithms.
* Understand various business processes pertaining to Analytics Development Process
* Collect, preprocess, and analyze large datasets to be used for training and testing machine learning models.
* Ensure data quality and integrity throughout the data pipeline.
* Conduct experiments to develop model and evaluate model performance and iterate on model improvements.
* Under the guidance of senior members, work with Data Engineering teams to deploy data science models into production environments.
* Monitor and maintain deployed models to ensure they perform as expected.
* Under the guidance of senior members, work closely with data architects, data engineers, and other stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Optimize machine learning models for performance, scalability, and efficiency.
* Be aware of latest advancements in machine learning and artificial intelligence.
* Explore and implement new machine learning and artificial intelligence techniques and tools to enhance the team's capabilities.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of machine learning models, algorithms, and processes.


 The Ideal Candidate
   

  

* The ideal candidate should have experience in Gen AI/LLM, python and SQL.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelors degree in Statistics, Machine Learning, Computer Science or related STEM fields (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math) with analytics development experience
* Proficiency in Python and SQL (mandatory).
* Familiarity with Python web frameworks.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and their machine learning services
* Awareness of Knowledge Graphs
* Utilize Docker for containerization of application services.
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, AWS CodeBuild/CodePipeline) and use Git for version control.
* Demonstrated skill in the use of applied analytics, descriptive statistics, feature extraction and predictive analytics on datasets
* Demonstrated skill at data visualization and storytelling for an audience of stakeholders


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Influences within peer group.
* Implements specific component(s) of the roadmap.
* Evaluates features using well known or prescribed recipes and appropriately down selects to valuable ones.
* Aware of models such as CART / SVM / RF / Neural Net and the associated sub\-models
* Knowledge on Gen AI/LLM
* Uses Cross Validation and other Verification \& Validation techniques to build robust models from large data sets.
* Understands the types of issues that impact data quality
* Performs basic data cleaning operations such as flagging missing and invalid data etc.
* Fits normal parameters to data and assess goodness of fit
* Can use and interpret t\-tests, ANOVA and basic hypothesis testing with good utilization of p\-values.
* Codes using modular practices for reusage and object\-oriented Effectively shows visualization of data exploration using box, bubble and matrix plots.
* Has a basic understanding of GE Aerospace business and how the tools they are developing create value.


 At GE Aerospace, we have a relentless dedication to the future of safe and more sustainable flight and believe in our talented people to make it happen. title: System Engineer (Level 1) – Infrastructure & Backup Support
description:
**Job Summary** 




  





 The System Engineer – Level 1 is responsible for providing first\-line technical support for IT infrastructure, backup operations, and end\-user services. The role includes monitoring backup jobs, managing support tickets, ensuring SLA compliance, performing initial troubleshooting, and escalating complex issues to senior engineers while delivering excellent customer service.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Backup Operations** 




  




* Monitor scheduled backup jobs and verify successful completion.
* Investigate and perform initial troubleshooting for backup failures.
* Re\-run failed backup jobs where applicable.
* Perform file and data restore requests based on customer requirements.
* Monitor backup storage utilization and report capacity issues.
* Assist in backup verification and periodic recovery testing.
* Escalate unresolved backup issues to senior support engineers.



  





**Ticket Management** 




  




* Log, classify, and prioritize support tickets.
* Respond to incidents and service requests within agreed SLA timelines.
* Update tickets with troubleshooting activities, progress, and resolution details.
* Ensure all tickets are accurately documented and closed upon successful resolution.
* Escalate issues according to established support procedures.
* Maintain ownership of assigned tickets until closure.



  





**SLA Management** 




  




* Monitor response and resolution times for all assigned incidents.
* Ensure compliance with customer service level agreements.
* Identify potential SLA breaches and escalate proactively.
* Follow up on pending tickets to ensure timely resolution.
* Prepare operational reports as required.



  





**Infrastructure Support** 




  




* Provide first\-level support for desktops, laptops, printers, and peripheral devices.
* Troubleshoot operating system and application issues.
* Support user account administration, password resets, and access requests.
* Monitor server availability and basic system health.
* Perform basic virtualization monitoring and health checks.
* Troubleshoot basic network connectivity issues.
* Assist with system updates and routine maintenance activities.



  





**Customer Support** 




  




* Provide professional remote and onsite technical support.
* Maintain regular communication with customers regarding incident status.
* Deliver support in accordance with organizational service standards.
* Coordinate with senior engineers during incident escalation.



  





**Documentation** 




  




* Maintain operational records and technical documentation.
* Update knowledge base articles and standard operating procedures.
* Record configuration changes and support activities.
* Ensure documentation is complete and accurate for audit purposes.



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Basic knowledge of server administration.
* Understanding of backup and recovery concepts.
* Basic knowledge of virtualization technologies.
* Familiarity with user administration and directory services.
* Basic networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, LAN/WAN).
* Experience using IT service management or ticketing systems.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and within a team environment.



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 




  




* Backup success rate.
* Backup failure resolution within SLA.
* First response time.
* Incident resolution within SLA.
* Ticket closure rate.
* Documentation quality.
* Customer satisfaction score.
* Escalation accuracy.
* Restore success rate.
* Compliance with operational procedures.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 1–2 years of experience in IT support, infrastructure support, or managed services.
* Basic understanding of backup, virtualization, networking, and Windows\-based environments.
* IT service management knowledge is an advantage.



  





**Personal Attributes** 




  




* Customer\-focused and service\-oriented.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good organizational and time management abilities.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and work under pressure.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills.
* Willingness to learn and develop technical skills.

* Prior experience in engine calibration, understanding of heavy duty emissions legilislation, and OBD calibration.

title: Associate- PEG (AI Solutions Engineer)
description:
**About us**





 Bain \& Company is a global management consulting firm that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
 





 In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.
 





  
 





**Who you will work with** 






 BCN PEG CoE provides specialized support to global teams across the private equity value chain, enabling clients to make key investment decisions. Our expertise lies in addressing critical diligence questions through a range of products such as survey analytics, digital diagnostic, workforce analytics and disruption assessment. Our teams work in a fast\-paced environment delivering consistent and impactful results at scale. In the last decade, we have witnessed an exponential growth, reaching \>250 members today from \~10 members in 2013\. We operate from 4 locations – 2 in India, 1 in Poland, and 1 in Mexico and operate across all 3 regions (EMEA, Americas and APAC). We work across industries, including Technology, Consumer Products, Retail and Healthcare. BCN PEG provides an opportunity to solve challenging business problems in a dynamic set\-up working closely with global Bain teams, acting as a thought\-partner and bringing deep technical expertise.
 





  
 





**What you’ll do** 






 As an Associate (Tech) at BCN PEG, you will bring specialized technical knowledge to product development of internal tools as well as help in end client delivery of cases. You will:
 



* Design, build, and maintain AI\-powered applications using LLMs (especially OpenAI Models) and related technologies
* Implement python\-based API integrations with LLM platforms to enable use cases such as summarization, classification, extraction, reasoning, and workflow automation
* Develop prompt engineering strategies and reusable prompt frameworks to ensure reliability, accuracy, and scalability of AI outputs
* Build AI agents and tools that orchestrate multi\-step workflows, tool calling, and interaction with structured and unstructured data sources
* Collaborate with consultants and case teams to translate business problems into practical AI solutions
* Evaluate and experiment with emerging AI frameworks, libraries, and tools for potential adoption
* Support supervisors in work planning, solution design, and brainstorming for AI initiatives
* Ensure solutions are robust, secure, well\-documented, and aligned with Bain’s engineering and governance standards
* Communicate technical concepts and insights clearly to non\-technical stakeholders
* Proactively drive self\-learning in AI, LLMs, and applied machine learning
* Contribute to knowledge sharing, documentation, and internal training within the PEG and broader BCN community




**About you** 






**Must\-have skills:** 




* Strong programming skills in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript
* Hands\-on experience working with LLM APIs such as OpenAI and Anthropic, including prompt design and response handling
* Experience building AI agents, workflows, or automation tools using LLMs
* Ability to build evaluation sets, guardrails, and regression checks to measure, monitor, and safeguard the quality and reliability of LLM outputs
* Understanding of context engineering techniques, limitations of LLMs, and methods to improve output quality
* Familiarity with REST APIs and integrating external services
* Working knowledge of data structures, basic algorithms, and software engineering best practices
* Experience using version control systems such as Git
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with evolving requirements
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical thinking skills
* Excellent English communication skills with the ability to explain technical ideas clearly




**Good\-to\-have skills:** 




* Experience with AI orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
* Exposure to vector databases and embeddings (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma)
* Basic understanding of machine learning concepts and NLP
* Familiarity with modern front\-end technologies such as Angular, React and HTMX
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Experience building internal tools, prototypes, or dashboards
* Ability to write clear technical documentation and usage guides




**Educational qualification \& Professional experience** 




* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field
* Strong academic credentials, analytical ability, and problem\-solving skills
* Work experience range: Undergraduate degree: 2 \- 4 years of experience in software development, AI engineering, or related roles
* Postgraduate degree: 0 \- 2 years of relevant experience
* Prior exposure to consulting, analytics, or business problem\-solving environments is preferred but not mandatory







  




**What makes us a great place to work** 






 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the \#1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

Its products are designed for horizontal and vertical integration into Smart Factories, enabling intelligent, fully interconnected production cells for customers.
   

**Role Description** 
 This full\-time, on\-site Design and Automation Engineer role is based in Chennai. The role involves designing and developing automation solutions for injection molding and auxiliary equipment, including mechanical, electrical, and control system components. Responsibilities include creating detailed design documentation, 3D models, and drawings; selecting and integrating sensors, actuators, and controllers; and programming automation sequences for robots and handling systems. The engineer will collaborate with cross\-functional teams on project specifications, testing, validation, and commissioning of automation cells, while ensuring safety, reliability, and energy efficiency. The role also includes troubleshooting existing systems, supporting continuous improvement initiatives, and providing technical input for customer\-specific solutions.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong skills in mechanical and electrical design, including CAD modeling, drawing creation, and component selection.
* Candidates should possess skills in industrial automation, such as PLC programming, robot programming, and integration of sensors and actuators.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of control systems, motion control, and safety standards relevant to industrial machinery and automation cells.
* Candidates should possess skills in testing, diagnostics, and troubleshooting of automated systems and production equipment.
* Candidates should possess strong analytical, problem\-solving, and documentation skills, along with the ability to collaborate in cross\-functional teams.
* Relevant engineering degree (Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or related field) and experience in plastics processing, injection molding, or industrial automation are beneficial.
* Familiarity with energy\-efficient design, Smart Factory concepts, and Industry 4\.0 integration is an advantage.

* You’ll be producing business requirements to inform future state design, as you support teams to understand and link the requirements to the overall domain strategy

**You’ll Also Need**
* Experience in Digital and Commercial Banking, delivering account reporting and payments solutions
* Expertise in ISO 20022 and payments transformation initiatives
* Experience in business analysis, including requirements gathering, process mapping, gap analysis, user story development, and acceptance criteria definition within Agile and Scrum teams
* Ability to collaborate with stakeholders, development, and QA teams using Jira and Confluence to deliver high\-quality digital banking solutions

title: Business Analyst I, Account Integrity
description:
**Description**
 Have you ever thought about what it takes to detect and prevent unauthorized activity among hundreds of millions of eCommerce transactions across the globe? What would you do to increase trust in an online marketplace where millions of buyers create and sign in to shop at Amazon? How would you build systems that evolve over time to proactively identify and neutralize new and emerging MO?
   

  

 Amazon’s Buyer Risk Prevention (BRP) team is looking for a passionate, results\-oriented Business Analyst to support Account Integrity’s mission is to prevent bad actors from taking over existing good Customer accounts (events referred to as ATOs), and from creating new Amazon accounts (bad actor accounts, or BAAs).
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As a Business Analyst in BRP, you will be responsible for analyzing terabytes of data to identify specific instances of risk, broader risk trends and points of customer friction, developing scalable solutions for prevention. In addition you will be responsible for building a robust set of operational and business metrics and will utilize metrics to determine improvement opportunities.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Understand the various operations across BRP
* Understand the requirements of stakeholders and map them with the data sources/data warehouse
* Design and develop highly available dashboards and metrics using Tableau, Excel and SQL.
* Provide wing\-to\-wing project lifecycle execution (project planning, execution, risk assessment and system availability)

title: Software Engineer – Frontend Developer
description:
****Company Description****
 Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.
   

  

 Renesas employs roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what’s next in electronics and the world.
   

  

****Job Description****
 Transforming Sourcing into a Competitive Advantage is the mission of Part Analytics,
 **an Altium**
**Company.** 
 Our AI\-powered supply management software empowers manufacturing companies
   

  

 to accelerate product development, improve profit margin and uncover hidden risks in the supply chain.
   

  

****About The Role****
 We are looking for a Software Engineer – Frontend to help in developing high quality, secured and high performant application. As a Frontend developer, you will have a major role to play in the software product development by analyzing the requirement, deciding approach and developing the application. As part of this role, you will be doing development, write unit test case, high level test case and deliver quality application.
   

  

****Job Description:****
* Develop high\-quality applications.
* Participate in sprint planning, task estimation and user story creation
* Design and implement testable and scalable code
* Utilize Gitlab/Github repository for source control
* Connect back\-end functionality to front\-end via current web technologies
* Customize elements of the user interface for meeting brand standards
* Ensure that all design elements work within a variety of screen sizes and browser types.
* Code, test, and troubleshoot to develop and modify the user interface
* Successful collaboration with backend developers
* Accurate estimation and timely completion of tasks
* Contribute to process improvements to drive efficiency and efficacy


****Qualifications****
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent from a reputed university.
* 3\+ years of experience (real world, not academic).
* Proficient with Angular 12 or higher
* Working knowledge of back\-end programming languages (Ex: Python, Java, JavaScript, NodeJS)
* Knowledge on any web server/app server configuration and deployment on AWS platform
* Experience using Source Control such as Git.
* Great design and problem\-solving skills, with a strong bias for quality and engineering excellence at scale.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.


****Additional Information****
 Altium Limited, a part of the Renesas Group and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a global software company accelerating the pace of electronics innovation. We are redefining electronic product creation in a software\-defined world with our industry\-first cloud\-based platform that unites every stakeholder and phase of electronics development.
   

  

 From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before. At Altium, our teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate globally, and help create the future of electronics development.
   

  

 We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

Every product, every design, every algorithm down to the tiniest detail is executed keeping the customers’ needs and convenience in mind. Our people are our greatest strength. Everyone at Groww is driven by ownership, customer\-centricity, integrity and the passion to constantly challenge the status quo.
 



 Are you as passionate about defying conventions and creating something extraordinary as we are? Let’s chat.
 



**Our Vision** 




 Every individual deserves the knowledge, tools, and confidence to make informed financial decisions. At Groww, we are making sure every Indian feels empowered to do so through a cutting\-edge multi\-product platform offering a variety of financial services. Our long\-term vision is to become the trusted financial partner for millions of Indians.
 



**Our Values** 




 Our culture enables us to be what we are — India’s fastest\-growing financial services company. It fosters an environment where collaboration, transparency, and open communication take center\-stage and hierarchies fade away. There is space for every individual to be themselves and feel motivated to bring their best to the table, as well as craft a promising career for themselves.
 



 The values that form our foundation are:
 


* Radical customer centricity
* Ownership\-driven culture
* Keeping everything simple
* Long\-term thinking
* Complete transparency

* Ensure quality at every level be it problem\-solving, design, code, or bug fixes.
* Should be able to collaborate with product managers, architects, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth execution of sprints.
* Own and unblock users on production issues, able to troubleshoot and fix production issues on priority.
* Can mentor and help other team members and ensure that the overall productivity of the team is high.



**What are we looking for :** 



* 7\- 8 years of experience in building scalable restful/soap microservice services.
* Good at high\-level design and implementation. Understanding of design patterns.
* Strong problem\-solving skills.
* Good understanding of data structures \& algorithms and their space \& time complexities.
* Strong hands\-on and practical working experience with Java and Spring.
* Excellent coding skills \- should be able to convert the design into code fluently.
* Strong technical aptitude and a good knowledge of CS fundamentals.
* B Tech in Computer Science or equivalent from a reputed college.
* You are expected to demonstrate good learnability and adopt technologies that help build large\-scale, performant, reliable, and sustainable systems.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
 Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

 As a Software Engineer, you will be an integral part of a dynamic, Agile engineering team, contributing to software development. You will collaborate with remote teams in a multicultural environment and help your colleagues excel. You will work in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment, tackling challenging problems with current technologies and tools. Your role includes brainstorming and implementing new solutions and modeling engineering best practices.
   

  

 This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Manager, Engineering.
   

  

**Responsibility**
* Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable full stack applications, APIs, web components, and services using modern frameworks and technologies
* Build production\-grade frontend and backend features using clean, maintainable, accessible, and testable code with strong focus on quality, reliability, and performance
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of cloud\-native services, microservices, and APIs operating in production environments
* Participate in the design and implementation of reusable UI components, backend services, and platform capabilities
* Collaborate effectively with product managers, designers, engineers, and other stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver impactful solutions
* Work within an Agile/Scrum development environment utilizing automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, version control systems, and peer code reviews
* Troubleshoot, debug, monitor, and resolve production issues using testing frameworks, observability tools, and application monitoring systems
* Contribute to continuous improvement by sharing technical knowledge, learning new technologies, and promoting software engineering best practices


 Job Designation
   

  

**Hybrid:** 
 Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation)
   

  

 Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.
   

  

 What you bring
   

  

**Basic**
* 5\+ years Full\-Stack development experience or equivalent
* Bachelors or Masters in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Systems, Informatics or equivalent
* Experience with data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and distributed systems fundamentals
* Experience working with back\-end technologies such as C\#, Go, Java or other modern programming languages


**Preferred**
* Experience in designing and developing integration solutions
* Experience in Unit testing and Integration testing
* Ability to lead integration workstream and provide expert\-level guidance for complex integrations from Docusign to third party systems
* Ability to provide expert level guidance to team members in developing integrations and interfaces between DocuSign and other third party systems


 Life at Docusign
   

  

**Working here**
 Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.
   

  

 We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.
   

  

**Accommodation**
 Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.
   

  

 If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.
   

  

 Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Software Engineer - Python (contractual role)
description:
We are looking for a strong, hands\-on Python Backend Engineer with excellent programming fundamentals, problem\-solving ability, and a clear understanding of software design.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be comfortable building backend applications using Python, designing APIs, modelling data, and writing clean, reliable, and well\-tested code. Advanced experience with microservices, distributed systems, asynchronous programming, or cloud\-native architecture is not mandatory, as these areas can be developed on the job.
   

  

 Candidates may use AI\-assisted development tools, but they must be able to independently review, explain, validate, debug, and take complete ownership of the generated code.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and maintain backend applications using Python
* Build clean and reliable REST APIs using FastAPI, Flask, Django, or similar frameworks
* Convert business requirements into clear technical implementations
* Apply strong programming fundamentals and object\-oriented design principles
* Design data models, entities, relationships, and database schemas
* Write readable, modular, maintainable, and testable code
* Debug application issues and perform structured root\-cause analysis
* Write unit tests and handle validation, edge cases, and failures
* Participate in code reviews and clearly communicate technical decisions
* Use AI and LLM\-based development tools responsibly while retaining complete understanding and ownership of the implementation


**Requirements**
* 2\-3 years of hands\-on software development experience
* Strong knowledge of Python fundamentals, including:
+ Data types and control flow
+ Functions, classes, objects, and inheritance
+ Encapsulation, abstraction, and polymorphism
+ Lists, dictionaries, sets, and tuples
+ Exceptions and error handling
+ Modules, packages, and dependency management
+ Iterators, generators, decorators, and context managers

* Strong understanding of object\-oriented programming and software design principles
* Good programming, logical reasoning, and problem\-solving ability
* Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and time and space complexity
* Experience building REST APIs using FastAPI, Flask, Django REST Framework, or similar frameworks
* Understanding of HTTP methods, status codes, validation, and API error handling
* Good understanding of database fundamentals, including:
+ Tables and relationships
+ Primary and foreign keys
+ Constraints and indexes
+ Transactions and query design

* Experience writing unit tests and debugging Python applications
* Ability to design simple and appropriate solutions without unnecessary abstractions
* Ability to clearly explain the behaviour and purpose of implemented code
* Ability to review and validate AI\-generated code before using it


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience with MySQL or PostgreSQL
* Familiarity with Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Celery, or cloud platforms
* Exposure to microservices and distributed systems
* Basic understanding of asynchronous programming using asyncio
* Experience working in a product\-focused or strong engineering environment
* Exposure to applications handling meaningful production traffic
* Basic frontend knowledge is an added advantage


**Benefits**
* Best\-in\-class salary: We hire strong talent and compensate accordingly
* Proximity Talks: Meet and learn from designers, engineers, product leaders, and AI practitioners
* Continuous learning: Work with a world\-class team and stay close to the latest in AI, engineering, and product development
* High\-impact work: Build AI\-first systems and products used at scale by global clients


**About Us**
 Proximity is the trusted technology, design, and consulting partner for some of the biggest Sports, Media, and Entertainment companies in the world. We're headquartered in San Francisco and have offices in Palo Alto, Dubai, Mumbai, and Bangalore.
   

  

 Since 2019, Proximity has built high\-impact, scalable products used by millions of users every day. Today, we are a global team of engineers, designers, product managers, and experts solving complex problems and building cutting\-edge technology at scale.

title: Associate - PEG (Full Stack Developer)
description:
**About us**





 Bain \& Company is a global management consulting firm that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
 





 In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.
 





  
 





**Who you will work with** 






 BCN PEG CoE provides specialized support to global teams across the private equity value chain, enabling clients to make key investment decisions. Our expertise lies in addressing critical diligence questions through a range of products such as survey analytics, digital diagnostic, workforce analytics and disruption assessment. Our teams work in a fast\-paced environment delivering consistent and impactful results at scale. In the last decade, we have witnessed an exponential growth, reaching \>250 members today from \~10 members in 2013\. We operate from 4 locations – 2 in India, 1 in Poland, and 1 in Mexico and operate across all 3 regions (EMEA, Americas and APAC). We work across industries, including Technology, Consumer Products, Retail and Healthcare. BCN PEG provides an opportunity to solve challenging business problems in a dynamic set\-up working closely with global Bain teams, acting as a thought\-partner and bringing deep technical expertise.
 





  
 





**What you’ll do** 






 As an Associate (Tech) at BCN PEG, you will bring specialized technical knowledge to the product development of internal tools, as well as help in end\-client delivery of cases. You will:
 



* Design, build, and maintain responsive, user\-friendly web applications with a strong focus on front\-end development
* Develop modern, interactive front\-end interfaces using React (with Vite), Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion to deliver polished, performant, and animated user experiences
* Build and integrate Node.js back\-end services and APIs, including the ability to stand up a simple Node.js application independently from scratch
* Translate design mockups and business requirements into clean, maintainable, and reusable components
* Collaborate with consultants and case teams to translate business problems into practical web applications
* Evaluate and experiment with emerging front\-end frameworks, libraries, and tools for potential adoption
* Support supervisors in work planning, solution design, and brainstorming for product initiatives
* Ensure applications are robust, secure, well\-documented, and aligned with Bain’s engineering and governance standards
* Communicate technical concepts and insights clearly to non\-technical stakeholders
* Proactively drive self\-learning in modern web development and emerging front\-end technologies
* Contribute to knowledge sharing, documentation, and internal training within the PEG and broader BCN community







  




**About you** 






**Must\-have skills:** 




* Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript
* Hands\-on experience building front\-end applications with React, using Vite as the build tool
* Proficiency with Tailwind CSS for styling and Framer Motion for animation and interaction design
* Strong understanding of modern front\-end architecture, component design, and responsive UI principles
* Working knowledge of Node.js, with the ability to build a simple Node.js application independently from scratch
* Familiarity with REST APIs and integrating external services
* Working knowledge of data structures, basic algorithms, and software engineering best practices
* Experience using version control systems such as Git
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with evolving requirements
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical thinking skills
* Excellent English communication skills with the ability to explain technical ideas clearly




**Good\-to\-have skills:** 




* Familiarity with other front\-end frameworks such as Vue, Svelte, or Angular
* Some background in Python
* Basic awareness of AI and LLM\-based tools and APIs
* Basic understanding of application deployment and hosting workflows
* Knowledge of relational and non\-relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis)
* Experience building internal tools, prototypes, or dashboards
* Ability to write clear technical documentation and usage guides




**Educational qualification \& Professional experience** 




* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* Strong academic credentials, analytical ability, and problem\-solving skills
* Work experience range: Undergraduate degree: 2 \- 4 years of experience in software development, AI engineering, or related roles
* Postgraduate degree: 0 \- 2 years of relevant experience
* Prior exposure to consulting, analytics, or business problem\-solving environments is preferred but not mandatory







  




**What makes us a great place to work** 






 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the \#1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Company Description:** 




 SplashData is a leading provider of security and productivity software applications for mobile professionals, businesses, and enterprise customers. The company’s flagship product, SplashID, has been the \#1 cross\-platform password manager for over a decade. SplashID is available on iOS, Android, Windows, Mac OS, and via the web, making it accessible across devices and platforms. Team members contribute to products that help users securely manage sensitive information while improving efficiency and digital safety.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 We are seeking a motivated Software Engineer to join our development team in Pune. In this role, your primary focus will be on developing, enhancing, and maintaining our core suite of applications using Flutter. You will be responsible for building clean UIs, integrating APIs, writing robust test suites, and optimizing performance.
 



 In addition to your primary Flutter responsibilities, you will assist in maintaining and debugging our legacy applications across
 **iOS, macOS, Android, Windows, and Web** 
 platforms, which are built on tech stacks from 10–12 years ago. This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer to deepen their cross\-platform engineering skills while receiving dedicated mentorship and support to master legacy systems.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* **Flutter Development** 
 : Build, enhance, and deploy high\-quality mobile, desktop and web applications using Flutter and Dart.
* **API Integration** 
 : Connect applications to RESTful APIs, microservices, and third\-party data sources.
* **Testing \& Quality** 
 : Develop and execute comprehensive unit, widget, and integration test suites to ensure application stability.
* **Performance \& Debugging** 
 : Profile, optimize, and debug app performance, memory usage, and UI rendering speeds.
* **Legacy Maintenance** 
 : Perform minor bug fixes and routine maintenance on legacy native applications (iOS, macOS, Android, Windows) with the guidance of senior team members.
* **Collaboration** 
 : Work closely with the engineering manager, software engineers, quality engineers, UI/UX designers, and backend engineers to deliver clean user experiences.



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications:** 



* **Experience** 
 : 1–3 years of professional software development experience, with a strong focus on mobile applications.
* **Flutter \& Dart** 
 : Proven hands\-on experience building apps using the Flutter framework and Dart language.
* **Networking** 
 : Strong understanding of HTTP protocols, JSON parsing, and state management solutions, such as Provider, Bloc, and Riverpod.
* **Testing Mindset** 
 : Experience writing automated unit and integration tests.
* **Tooling** 
 : Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and standard debugging tools (Flutter DevTools, Xcode, Android Studio).
* **Adaptability** 
 : A strong willingness to learn, explore, and work with older, legacy codebases, such as Objective\-C, Java, and C\#/.NET, with provided team support.
* **Work Authorization \& Presence** 
 : Must be located in or willing to relocate to Pune and be able to work from our Pune office at least 2 days a week



  





**Nice\-to\-Have Skills:** 



* Basic understanding of native build tools (Gradle, CocoaPods).
* Familiarity with App Store Connect and Google Play Console deployment processes.
* Previous exposure to desktop application development (Windows/macOS).
* Familiarity with agentic AI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to enhance development productivity.



 ﻿
 



**Location:** 




 Pune, India (Hybrid role: minimum of 2 days per week in\-office)
 



  





 Candidates available to join immediately will be given priority.

description:
**About Flexport:**
-------------------



At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That's why it's our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We're shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.



The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

**About the role**
------------------



We're looking for an experienced HR Generalist, based in Mumbai, to own the full employee lifecycle and people programs across India and the Subcontinent. This is a true generalist role: you'll run recruiting end to end, manage onboarding through offboarding, and drive the HR operations, compliance, and employee\-experience work that keeps our teams thriving. You'll be the local face of the APAC People team, making sure our ambitious growth is supported by a robust and effective people strategy. We're building a People function that works smarter with AI, so you'll be encouraged to use modern AI\-powered tools to automate manual work, sharpen sourcing, and free up more time for the human side of HR.


**What You'll do**
------------------


* Own full\-cycle recruiting for a range of roles across departments—building search strategies, sourcing active and passive candidates, screening, interviewing, and guiding candidates through hiring and onboarding.
* Track sourcing data to focus effort on the channels with the highest ROI, and partner closely with hiring managers to attract, assess, and close top talent.
* Drive proactive recruiting initiatives and help build the Flexport employer brand across the region.
* Communicate candidate pipelines, funnel metrics, and performance data clearly and regularly to internal stakeholders.
* Serve as the local representative of the APAC People team, enhancing employee experience across the full lifecycle from onboarding to offboarding.
* Lead local HR operations including data management, employee support, reporting and analytics, process improvement, payroll support, and policy development.
* Maintain accurate HRIS data in Workday, run audits, and resolve employee tickets.
* Leverage AI\-powered tools to automate repetitive HR tasks, source and screen candidates faster, and surface insights from people data.
* Act as the local expert on HR policy and ensure HR compliance across the region.
* Take on additional projects from the global and regional People leadership team as needed.

**What You'll bring**
---------------------


* A BA/BS degree and 6\+ years of experience, including full\-cycle recruiting at a search firm or fast\-growing company.
* A strong track record of processing a wide range of HR transactions and a solid understanding of HR best practices across the APAC region.
* Proven ability to build rapport with hiring managers and cross\-functional partners at all levels.
* A creative approach to finding great people, with the ability to build candidate networks and channel connections.
* A drive for results—you see processes through end to end and are motivated by data and metrics.
* Humility: no task is too big or too small.
* Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail.
* Hands\-on experience with Workday (HCM, recruiting, or reporting) is strongly preferred.
* Comfort adopting AI\-powered HR and recruiting tools, with curiosity about how AI can make people processes faster and better.

At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients


At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas – Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease – we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.


Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

**Senior Associate, Talent Management, University Relations – Intern Program**

**What you will do**


Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will manage Amgen’s intern program end to end as part of the University Relations team, creating a structured, engaging, and high\-impact experience for interns from Day 1 onboarding through program completion and exit. You will partner closely with hiring managers, business leaders, Talent Acquisition, HR partners, and university stakeholders to ensure interns are aligned to meaningful projects, receive timely support, and experience Amgen’s mission, culture, and career opportunities in a compelling way.


You will play a key role in strengthening Amgen’s early talent pipeline by driving intern program operations, development experiences, bootcamps, evaluations, engagement activities, and employer branding initiatives such as intern testimonials and program success stories. This role requires strong program management, stakeholder partnership, communication, and execution discipline to deliver a consistent, inclusive, and impactful intern experience across functions.

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* Own the end\-to\-end intern program lifecycle, including onboarding, engagement, learning experiences, performance check\-ins, evaluations, conversion support, and exit activities.
* Partner with hiring managers to ensure interns are assigned relevant, well\-scoped, and business\-aligned projects that provide meaningful learning and measurable impact.
* Design and execute intern onboarding experiences that help interns understand Amgen’s mission, ways of working, expectations, resources, and support channels from Day 1\.
* Assess the health of the intern cohort through structured touchpoints, pulse checks, manager feedback, intern evaluations, and program metrics.
* Plan, coordinate, and run intern bootcamps, learning sessions, speaker series, networking events, project showcases, and engagement forums.
* Drive intern communication rhythm, including program calendars, milestone updates, manager guidance, intern reminders, feedback timelines, and closing communications.
* Work with managers and HR partners to identify and resolve intern experience risks, project misalignment, engagement concerns, or performance\-related issues in a timely manner.
* Lead intern performance and evaluation processes, ensuring feedback is collected, documented, reviewed, and used to support development and potential conversion decisions.
* Build and execute intern branding initiatives, including intern testimonials, project spotlights, success stories, campus\-facing content, and internal storytelling.
* Partner with University Relations and Talent Acquisition teams to align intern program activities with campus hiring, employer branding, and early talent strategy.
* Track intern program data, feedback, participation, satisfaction, project outcomes, and conversion indicators to identify insights and continuous improvement opportunities.
* Create and maintain program playbooks, onboarding materials, manager guides, evaluation templates, communication plans, and process documentation.
* Support intern exit processes, including final presentations, feedback capture, knowledge transition, offboarding coordination, and alumni engagement opportunities.

**What we expect of you**


We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients.

**Basic Qualifications:**


Master's degree / Bachelor's degree and 5 to 9 years of experience in Human Resources, Talent Management, Talent Acquisition, University Relations, Program Management, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field

**Must\-Have Skills**

* Prior experience designing and managing internship, early talent, university relations, talent management, or campus programs end to end.
* Experience managing the pre\-placement offer process, including intern evaluation outcomes, stakeholder alignment, offer recommendations, communication, and conversion tracking.
* Strong program management skills with the ability to manage timelines, stakeholders, events, communications, risks, and deliverables across multiple workstreams.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with hiring managers and business leaders to define meaningful intern projects, clarify expectations, and drive accountability.
* Experience designing and executing onboarding, bootcamps, learning sessions, engagement events, evaluations, or development programs.
* Ability to assess program health through data, feedback, surveys, manager inputs, and intern experience indicators.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across interns, managers, HR partners, Talent Acquisition, business leaders, and university partners.
* Experience creating program documentation, process guides, communication plans, dashboards, reports, presentations, and leadership updates.
* Fluent in enterprise collaboration platforms such as O365, SharePoint Online, MS Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, and related productivity tools.
* Ability to use AI and automation tools responsibly to improve program planning, communication, reporting, feedback synthesis, and operational efficiency.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

**Good\-to\-Have Skills:**

* Experience in campus recruiting, university engagement, early career programs, internship program design, or employer branding.
* Experience building intern engagement strategies, alumni communities, ambassador programs, testimonials, or campus\-facing storytelling campaigns.
* Working knowledge of HR systems preferably Workday, applicant tracking systems, learning platforms, survey tools, dashboards, or people analytics solutions.
* Ability to translate intern and manager feedback into actionable program improvements and scalable operating practices.

**Soft Skills:**

* Strong ownership mindset with excellent planning, organization, and follow\-through.
* Ability to build trusted relationships with interns, hiring managers, HR partners, business leaders, and university stakeholders.
* High degree of initiative, judgment, and comfort operating independently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Passion for early talent development, inclusive experiences, continuous improvement, and strengthening the future talent pipeline.

**What you can expect of us**


As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well\-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The Recruiter Intern will support the end\-to\-end recruitment process by sourcing candidates, screening profiles, coordinating interviews, maintaining recruitment data, and ensuring a smooth candidate experience. This internship provides hands\-on exposure to talent acquisition, recruitment tools, and HR operations while developing strong communication and coordination skills.

Key Roles \& Responsibilities

* Source candidates through job portals, social media platforms, employee referrals, and other recruitment channels.
* Screen resumes based on job requirements and shortlist suitable candidates.
* Conduct initial telephonic screenings to assess candidate suitability.
* Schedule and coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers.
* Follow up with candidates regarding interview schedules, feedback, and joining formalities.
* Maintain and update candidate databases, interview trackers, and recruitment reports.
* Post job openings on various job portals and social media platforms.
* Build and maintain a talent pipeline for current and future hiring needs.
* Coordinate with internal departments to understand hiring requirements.
* Assist in preparing offer letters, internship letters, and other recruitment\-related documentation.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.
* Participate in recruitment drives, campus hiring, walk\-in interviews, and job fairs, if required.
* Support the HR team in onboarding activities and other HR initiatives as assigned.

Pay: ₹5,000\.00 \- ₹8,000\.00 per month

title: Data Analysis
description:
**Job Description:**


We are looking for a skilled HR manager to oversee all aspects of Human Resources practices and processes. You will support business needs and ensure the proper implementation of company strategy and objectives. The goal is to promote corporate values and enable business success through human resources management, including job design, recruitment, performance management, training \& development, employment cycle changes, talent management, and facilities management services.


Responsibilities:

* Enhances the organization's human resources by planning, implementing, and evaluating employee relations and human resources policies, programs, and practices.
* Maintains the work structure by updating job requirements and job descriptions for all positions.
* Supports organization staff by establishing and interviewing program; counselling managers on candidate selection; conducting and analyzing exit interviews; and recommending changes.
* Prepares employees for assignments by establishing and conducting orientation and training programs.
* Manages a pay plan by conducting periodic pay surveys; scheduling and conducting job evaluations; preparing pay budgets; monitoring and scheduling individual pay actions; and recommending, planning, and implementing pay structure revisions.
* Ensures planning, monitoring, and appraisal of employee work results by training managers to coach and discipline employees; scheduling management conferences with employees; hearing and resolving employee grievances; and counselling employees and supervisors.
* Implements employee benefits programs and informs employees of benefits by studying and assessing benefit needs and trends; recommending benefit programs to management; directing the processing of benefit claims; obtaining and evaluating benefit contract bids; awarding benefit contracts; and designing and conducting educational programs on benefit programs.
* Ensures legal compliance by monitoring and implementing applicable human resource federal and state requirements, conducting investigations, maintaining records, and representing the organization at hearings.

**Role Summary**

An exciting opportunity exists to join Flutter’s Internal Controls Assurance team. We are seeking to hire a talented Internal Controls Senior Manager to join the team. The ideal candidates will have experience working in a Business Controls function for a major multinational company or audit firm. The Flutter Internal Controls team is a key part of our governance framework and an important component of the second line of defense. A key Group\-wide function, it is responsible for promoting high standards of internal controls to reduce financial risk, delivering the annual internal controls testing plan, and providing guidance to the business on what robust controls look like. The roles involve providing an independent opinion on the design adequacy of the control framework and providing objective assurance to confirm that the controls are operating as expected.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Audit Planning \& Execution:


* Planning and execution of internal controls testing plan under the guidance of Business Controls Assurance Lead in accordance with defined quality standards and deadlines.
* Liaising with external auditors as required.

Team Management:


* Managing the team of Analyst, Senior Auditors and Audit Managers, ensuring their work is completed on time and supporting with any queries.
* Performing review of the testing performed by the team and providing guidance as required.
* Identification of skill gaps within the team and running formal/ informal trainings to upskill the team members.

Stakeholder Management:


* Identifying and communicating Business control deficiencies to management along with monitoring of management’s responses as well as implementation of agreed remediation plans.
* Continuously communicating with Internal Controls Senior Management on the progress to plan.
* Working with the Internal Controls Lead, internal controls colleagues including transformation and Finance / Business Heads, to improve internal control environment.
* Collaborate with the teams of other key internal stakeholders who have ownership of the processes to be tested, to deliver the Internal Controls plan and address concerns they may have.

**EXCEL IN THIS ROLE YOU NEED TO HAVE**

* Qualified accountant (ACA, CPA, ACCA, or CIMA)
* PCAOB audit experience of 10 to 12 years and experience in a professional services or industry role.
* Experience delivering ICFR activities day\-to\-day, across at least one whole financial year cycle.
* Experience of navigating material weakness or significant deficiency of remediation is advantageous, but not essential.
* Some experience of significant finance transformation activities in ICFR or with ICFR impacts, such as a GRC implementation, global process owner deployment, an ERP implementation, or technology enablement of the annual ICFR cycle, is advantageous, but not essential.
* Experience of betting, gaming or online entertainment businesses is advantageous, but not essential.
* Experience of Oracle ERP and related Oracle systems is advantageous, but not essential.
* Delivering the Internal Controls testing and assessments on time.
* Achieving an unqualified ICFR opinion from the external auditors for the year ended 31 December 2025\.
* Maintaining an unqualified ICFR opinion from the external auditors across the period of finance transformation, most significantly in 2026 and 2027\.
* Building the foundations for a culture where ICFR is seen as a critical part of the Group’s external financial reporting, and where roles contributing to ICFR are seen to be excellent progression opportunities into more senior finance roles.
* Good project management and organisation skills, to be able to manage the delivery of one or several workstreams to short\-term and long\-term deadlines.
* Good management skills, for directing the day\-to\-day activities of the internal and external support.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, to be able to clearly articulate the status of work and the risks that may cause timetable or cost challenges.
* Good ICFR skills, covering Business processes, is essential.
* Able to operate in a fast\-paced environment in a management role that is empowered to deliver change.

* **Free Meals, Cab Allowance, and a Home Office Setup Allowance.**
* Employer PF Contribution, gratuity, **Personal Accident \& Life Insurance.**
* Sharesave Plan to purchase discounted company shares.
* Volunteering Leave and Team Events to build connections.
* Recognition through the **Kudos Platform and Referral Rewards.**

**WHY CHOOSE US:**

Flutter is an equal\-opportunity employer and values the unique perspectives and experiences that everyone brings. Our message to colleagues and stakeholders is clear: everyone is welcome, and every voice matters. We have ambitious growth plans and goals for the future. Here's an opportunity for you to play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Flutter Entertainment India.

title: Onboarding Specialist
description:
**Job Title:** HR Onboarding Specialist

**Location:** Bengaluru

**Reports to:** Manager HR

**About Ceres India**

At Ceres India Private Limited, we support initiatives that help communities recover, rebuild, and strengthen resilience. As part of the Ceres Global network of companies, we contribute to disaster recovery, infrastructure restoration, environmental services, and critical response operations through engineering, technology, innovation, and operational excellence. From India, we help enable faster decisions, stronger delivery, and meaningful outcomes where they matter most. The purpose is at the core of what we do. We are building an environment where talent can do meaningful work, take ownership, grow with the business, and be part of something larger than themselves.

**Driven by Purpose, Powered by People**


At Ceres India, we believe you’re more than just an employee; you’re part of a team with a purpose and a meaningful mission. Every team member plays a vital role in restoring hope, helping communities recover and rebuild.


We value initiative, respect diversity, and give our people the freedom to lead. We offer competitive pay, growth opportunities, travel, and a culture built on resilience and teamwork. If you show up with compassion, share the commitment, react with urgency, and deliver solutions, you’ll fit right in. We don’t just respond to challenges; we rise to them.

**What We Are Looking For**


The Onboarding Specialist – US Operations is responsible for managing end\-to\-end employee onboarding, ensuring a smooth and compliant transition for new hires using HRMS platforms such as Paycom. The role partners closely with HR, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, and IT teams to deliver an excellent new\-hire experience.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage full\-cycle onboarding for US employees (exempt and non\-exempt).
* Initiate and track I\-9 verification and E\-Verify compliance
* Ensure completion of W\-4, state tax forms, direct deposit, and policy acknowledgements
* Configure and maintain onboarding workflows in HRMS tool (Paycom preferred)
* Initiate and track pre\-employment checks, documentation, drug screening vendors and compliance forms
* Coordinate with Payroll and Benefits teams for timely employee setup
* Ensure data accuracy across HR systems and employee records
* Communicate onboarding timelines and expectations to new hires and stakeholders
* Support audits, reporting, and HR metrics related to onboarding
* Troubleshoot HRMS system issues and provide user support

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* 5\-6 years of experience in US onboarding / HR operations
* Hands\-on experience with HRMS tools – Paycom (preferred)
* Strong understanding of onboarding compliance and employment documentation
* Strong knowledge of US employment compliance (I\-9, E\-Verify, W\-4, state new\-hire reporting)
* Excellent attention to detail and data management skills
* Strong communication and stakeholder coordination abilities
* Experience supporting US onboarding processes is a plus
* Flexibility to work across US Timezones

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting multi\-state US onboarding
* Exposure to high\-volume or remote onboarding
* Knowledge of US payroll and benefits processes
* Experience working with background check vendors

**What to Expect**


This is a fast\-paced, detail\-oriented role focused on delivering a seamless onboarding experience for new hires across the US. You'll manage multiple onboarding activities simultaneously, ensuring compliance with employment requirements while coordinating closely with HR, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, IT, and hiring managers. Success in this role requires strong organization, accuracy, and the ability to adapt to changing hiring volumes and priorities while providing excellent support to new employees and stakeholders.

**Why Join Ceres India?**


At Ceres India, you won’t just have a job, you’ll have a mission. Your work will directly impact the speed and strength of community recovery after disasters.


We offer:

* A collaborative, mission\-driven culture.
* Opportunities for professional growth and advancement.
* The chance to make a lasting difference for communities.

description:

title: Global Payroll Specialist - Europe and Africa
description:
Envoy Global is a proven innovator in the global immigration space. Our mission combines our industry\-leading tech platform with holistic service to streamline, simplify and expedite the immigration process for employers and individuals.



We now have an exciting opportunity within Envoy Global's Human Resources team for an experienced **Payroll Specialist** to join us on a full‑time basis. This role is integral to ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely payroll operations across multiple international regions including the **UK, Europe, and Africa**.



As a key member of the HR function, the Payroll Specialist will manage end‑to‑end payroll processing, maintain and analyze confidential payroll data, and serve as a primary payroll resource for employees across multiple countries. This position will work closely with our Payroll Manager, Country Managers, HRIS teams, and external vendors to ensure flawless payroll execution, adherence to country‑specific regulations, and exceptional employee support. The individual will also play a vital role in driving process accuracy, maintaining statutory compliance, and supporting key finance and HR initiatives across the organization.



**As our Payroll Specialist, you will be required to:**


* Monthly end to end payroll processing for UK, Germany, Kenya, Namibia and South Africa.
* Review and prepare multi country payroll monthly for hourly and salaried employees in accordance with Country, regional, and local laws, and standard accounting principles.
* Expertise\[JS2\.1]\[JS3\.1]\[JS4\.1] in handling multicurrency payroll for UK, European and African countries and exchange rates where applicable.
* Support our Payroll Manager with global payroll processes
* Ensure compliance with HMRC regulations. Process PAYE, NIC, student loans. Administer statutory payments. Year\-end activities P69,P11D,P45's
* Ensure compliance with local tax authorities in Africa, Manage local statutory deductions, pension funds, NHIF/medical schemes
* Maintain \& audit current payroll system for time \& attendance, employee records, etc. in preparation of payroll processing
* Partner with country managers and business HRs in the country to ensure all timekeeping tasks are completed, and support troubleshooting system issues
* Process voluntary deductions, garnishments, child support orders, tax levies, quarterly tax verifications, in accordance with all relevant laws
* Support tax\-related reconciliations
* Partner with HRIS, local vendors, tax authorities and payroll providers, where appropriate, to ensure payroll tax payment deadlines and compliance requirements are met in all jurisdictions
* Answer employee questions related to time and attendance, paychecks, deductions, and taxes
* Support Finance and HR teams with special projects and reports as required
* Region specific duties:  

 UK: Ensure compliance with HMRC regulations, processing PAYE, NIC, student loans, statutory payments and year\-end tax related activities  

 Africa: ensuring compliance with local tax authorities including but not limited to SARS, KRA, FIRS, ZIMRA, URA etc) as well as managing local statutory deductions such as PAYE, Social Security, Pension Funds, NHIF/Medical Schemes.
  


**To apply for this role, you should possess the following skills, experience and qualifications:**


* Working knowledge of the Country specific taxation, statutory and benefit related wage and hour legislation
* Experienced in MS Excel including V\-Lookups, Pivot Tables
* Experience with processing global payroll and liaison with vendors
* Ability to navigate through and learn HRIS/payroll systems quickly
* CPP or similar credentials preferred
* Able to work across time zones
* 3 to 6 years of experience processing payroll for a multi\-national employer, demonstrating knowledge of country specific payroll tax regulations, specifically experience in the UK, Germany and South Africa is a requirement.
* Graduation or above


***If this role excites you, please take a moment to complete the questionnaire below and attach your current resume. We look forward to your prompt response.***
