title: Regional Human Resources Business Partner
description:
**Description:**  

Where will your career take you next? Let’s find out together.
  
  

At Zurich Cover\-More, we’re proud to be one of the world’s leading travel insurance and assistance providers. Each year, we protect more than 20 million travellers worldwide, making sure we’re there every step of their journey with proactive care, personalised cover and specialist support. Zurich Cover\-More partners with many of the world’s best\-known brands – think major airlines, travel giants, top banks, credit card providers, and large retailers – to deliver more care, more cover, for all.
  
  

Launched in December 2024, Zurich Cover\-More is the global travel brand of Zurich Insurance Group, one of the world’s leading multi\-line insurers. Our family of customer\-facing brands includes trusted names like Travel Guard, Cover\-More Travel Insurance, Travelex Insurance, Universal Assistance, World Travel Protection, Freely, and Blue Insurance. Together, we’re redefining what it means to travel safely and with confidence. Whether it’s a long\-awaited holiday, a last\-minute business trip, or an unexpected detour, we deliver in the moments that matter.
  
  

**What you’ll be doing:**  

Reporting into the HRBP Lead based in Malaysia, you will provide localised hands\-on support, while working in a global environment.
  
  

* Lead HR operations and compliance activities across India, ensuring adherence to employment legislation, statutory requirements, payroll processes, benefits administration, and vendor management.
* Manage the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, probation reviews, employee relations matters, performance management support, and HR documentation.
* Partner with managers and business leaders to provide practical HR advice, policy guidance, and people solutions that align with business objectives and regional HR strategy.
* Drive HR reporting and projects, including workforce reporting, budget planning, vendor renewals, compliance audits, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Enhance employee engagement and capability development by supporting learning programs, employee experience initiatives, and regional People \& Culture programs


**What skills and experience you’ll bring on this journey:**  

* 3–5 years' experience in HR Generalist and/or HR Business Partner roles.
* Strong understanding of Indian employment legislation, labour compliance, and HR operations.
* Experience managing multiple HR priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong stakeholder management and relationship\-building skills.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and advise managers.
* High attention to detail and strong organisational skills.
* Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion.
* Comfortable working across local and regional teams in a matrix environment.


Why you’ll love working with us!
  
  

We value optimism, caring, togetherness, reliability, results\-orientation, and forward\-thinking.
  
  

We have more than 3000 employees worldwide. We are a global group of digital specialists, actuaries, marketers, doctors, nurses, case managers, claims specialists, finance experts, customer service and corporate services professionals. We share a global purpose to look after travellers, at every step of their journey.
  
  

Job flexibility. We understand the importance of making sure that work fits into your life, not the other way around. Our hybrid approach ensures you can maintain work\-life balance with the flexibility of 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home, after an initial training period.
  
  

Career growth. This is an extremely exciting time for us at Zurich Cover\-More, as we rapidly expand our business across the globe. We’re committed to helping our people thrive through a comprehensive onboarding experience, continuous professional development, and a supportive work environment that empowers growth at every stage of your career.
  
  

Take the time you need, for you and your community. We encourage you to take the time you need when you need it. We offer regular annual and personal leave benefits along with anniversary leave, volunteer leave and a comprehensive paid parental leave scheme.
  
  

Diversity and inclusion. We respect who you are and thoroughly embrace diversity. Wherever life has taken you, we welcome you to bring your whole self to work. Just be you – because that’s exactly who we’re looking for.
  
  

**We also offer some other perks including:**  

Mediclaim insurance cover in case of any health emergency
  
Coverage under group personal accident insurance
  
Flexible and compressed work weeks and hybrid working options.
  
Generous range of paid leave – 21 annual leave days, 6 sick leave days, 12 public holidays
  
An extra day off for you to take on your birthday or your annual work anniversary.
  
  

Appy today and let’s go to great places together!

description:
**Job Title:** 
 Senior Human Resources Manager (India)
 



**Location:** 
 India
 



**Position Summary** 




 The Senior HR Manager will lead and oversee all aspects of Human Resources for the India operations, serving as a trusted business partner to leadership while driving HR strategies that support organizational goals. This role is responsible for employee relations, compensation and benefits, talent engagement and retention, onboarding, policy implementation, compliance, and HR operations. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing end\-to\-end HR functions in India, with a proven track record in fostering a positive employee experience, building scalable HR processes, and ensuring compliance with applicable labor laws and organizational policies
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**HR Strategy \& Business Partnership** 



* Partner with business leaders to align HR initiatives with organizational objectives
* Provide strategic HR guidance on workforce planning, organizational design, talent management, and employee development
* Drive HR programs that support business growth, productivity, and employee engagement
* Act as a trusted advisor to managers on people\-related matter



**Employee Relations** 



* Lead employee relations activities, ensuring a positive and productive work environment
* Manage employee grievances, investigations, disciplinary actions, and conflict resolution
* Coach managers on employee relations issues and best practices
* Foster a culture of trust, inclusion, accountability, and open communication
* Ensure fair and consistent application of company policies and procedures



  





**Compensation \& Benefits** 



* Design, implement, and administer compensation programs aligned with market benchmarks and business objective
* Conduct compensation analysis and recommend salary structures, incentive plans, and reward programs
* Manage annual compensation review processes, promotions, and merit increases
* Oversee benefits administration and vendor relationships to ensure competitive and cost\-effective programs
* Monitor market trends and recommend enhancements to compensation and benefits offering



  





**Employee Engagement \& Retention** 



* Develop and execute employee engagement and retention strategies
* Analyze employee feedback and engagement data to identify opportunities for improvement
* Lead employee surveys, action planning, recognition programs, and cultural initiatives
* Support leadership in building a high\-performance and employee\-centric culture
* Implement programs focused on employee well\-being, career growth, and retention



  





**Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding** 



* Collaborate with recruitment teams and hiring managers to support talent acquisition effort
* Ensure effective onboarding programs that accelerate employee integration and productivity
* Continuously enhance the new\-hire experience and onboarding processes
* Support workforce planning and talent pipeline initiatives



  





**Payroll \& HR Operations** 



* Oversee payroll coordination to ensure accurate and timely processing
* Work closely with finance and payroll vendors to resolve payroll\-related issue
* Ensure proper administration and maintenance of employee records and HR systems
* Monitor HR metrics and provide insights to leadership
* Drive process improvements and HR operational excellence



  





**Performance Management \& Employee Development** 



* Lead performance management processes, including goal setting, performance reviews, and development planning
* Support managers in managing employee performance and career progression
* Identify learning and development needs and coordinate training initiatives
* Promote succession planning and leadership development programs



  





**Policy Development \& Compliance** 



* Develop, update, and implement HR policies and procedures
* Ensure compliance with Indian labor laws, employment regulations, and statutory requirement
* Monitor changes in legislation and recommend policy updates as needs
* Support internal audits and compliance reviews
* Maintain confidentiality and safeguard employee date



  





**Qualifications\& Education** 



* Bachelor's degree in human resources, Business Administration, Management, or related field
* MBA or Master's degree in Human Resources preferred
* Professional HR certifications are highly desirable



**Experience** 



* 10\+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 5 years in a managerial or senior HR leadership role
* Demonstrated experience managing all core HR functions within India
* Strong experience in employee relations, compensation design, benefits administration, engagement and retention programs, payroll coordination, onboarding, and policy implementation
* Experience supporting fast\-growing, multi\-location, or global organizations preferred



  





**Knowledge \& Skils** 



* Strong knowledge of Indian labor laws, employment regulations, and HR compliance requirement
* Expertise in compensation benchmarking and reward program design
* Proven employee relations and conflict resolution capabilities
* Strong understanding of payroll processes and statutory compliance
* Excellent stakeholder management and business partnering skill
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Proficiency with HRIS, payroll systems, and Microsoft Office applications



  





**Key Competencies** 



* Strategic Thinking
* Business Partnership
* Employee Advocacy
* Leadership and People Management
* Influencing and Negotiation
* Change Management
* Conflict Resolution
* Data\-Driven Decision Making
* Organizational Effectiveness
* Collaboration and Relationship Building



**Success Measures** 



* Improved employee engagement and retention metrics
* Strong compliance and audit outcome.
* Effective resolution of employee relations matters
* Timely and accurate payroll and benefits administration
* Successful implementation of HR programs and policies
* Positive employee experience across the entire employee lifecycle



  





 This role is ideal for an experienced HR leader who combines strategic thinking with operational excellence and can drive a high\-performance, compliant, and employee\-centric workplace across India operations

With a global presence spanning the US, Canada, Europe, Colombia, Mexico, and India, Flexton offers its clients cost\-effective solutions through onsite, offshore, and nearshore models. Flexton provides its employees with opportunities for growth, meaningful work, and continuous learning!

* Competitive base salary with performance incentives

* Opportunities for professional development and growth
* Collaborative, fast paced, and innovative work culture

title: Graduate Engineer Trainee
description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.

**Job Summary:**


GCC Vadodara campus seeks to hire Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) / LCA Analyst who can contribute to the growth of Xylem's Global Capability Center and its expansion into sustainable technology and business solutions. The selected candidate will be responsible for conducting life cycle assessments for our global product development teams. If you are excited and passionate, we want to hear from you!

**Principal Responsibilities:**

* Support Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) studies through data collection, modeling, and analysis.
* Collect, organize, and maintain product, manufacturing, and environmental data.
* Assist in preparing LCA reports, Product Sustainability Reports (PSRs) and Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs).
* Work with cross\-functional teams to gather products and process information.
* Learn and use LCA software tools such as SimaPro or equivalent.
* Ensure data accuracy, documentation and compliance with internal quality standards.
* Stay updated on sustainability standards, LCA methodologies and industry best practices

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Environmental, Chemical, Industrial, Production Engineering or a related discipline.
* 0–1 year of experience (Freshers are encouraged to apply).
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Eagerness to learn sustainability concepts and environmental assessment tools.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Basic understanding of sustainability, carbon footprint or Life Cycle Assessment concepts.
* Familiarity with ISO 14040/14044 or Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs) is an advantage.
* Exposure to LCA software (SimaPro, GaBi, OpenLCA, or One Click LCA) through academic projects or internships is desirable.
* Knowledge of product design and development.
* Knowledge of manufacturing industry process.
* Adaptability to work with different work cultures and time zones.

**What You’ll Gain:**

* Hands\-on experience in industrial Life Cycle Assessment.
* Exposure to global sustainability projects and product development.
* Training on LCA software, international standards and EPD development.
* Opportunity to work with global engineering and sustainability teams.
* A structured learning path toward becoming an LCA and Product Sustainability professional.


Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re\-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

* Basic understanding of technology concepts (APIs, data flow, IoT)

title: Content Writer
description:
**Content Writer**

**The Role \-** 

Most content roles end at the Google Doc. This one does not.

At Cidroy, you'll own the company's organic growth engine, from strategy and writing to rankings, AI visibility, and business impact. Success is measured by traffic, leads, and whether AI models cite us when buyers ask questions in our category.

We build mission\-critical software for high\-security, industrial, and enterprise environments where accuracy matters. Explaining complex technical products clearly, while making them discoverable through search and AI, is the core challenge.

You will own the company's content roadmap across every organic channel. You'll decide what gets created, what gets updated, and what gets removed based on performance.

**Who Should Apply \-**

Experience is not the deciding factor here.

If you can demonstrate exceptional writing, strong SEO execution, and the ability to own outcomes, we want to hear from you. Freshers who genuinely meet the expectations of this role are encouraged to apply alongside experienced candidates.

**What You'll Own \-** 

* Content strategy across the website, blog, product pages, documentation, case studies, and comparison pages
* Clear, technically accurate writing for technical buyers
* Brand voice across every content surface
* Content audits, refreshes, and pruning low\-performing pages
* Keyword research, search intent mapping, and content briefs
* On\-page SEO including metadata, internal linking, schema, and content structure
* Identifying technical SEO issues and working with developers to resolve them
* GEO and AEO through AI\-friendly content structure, entity clarity, FAQs, and schema
* Search Console health including indexing, sitemaps, canonicals, and coverage issues
* Performance reporting across GA4, Search Console, and social analytics
* LinkedIn, newsletter, and content repurposing across channels
* Community engagement where the audience already exists
* Prioritizing future content investments based on data

**Must Have \-** 

**Writing**

* A portfolio that demonstrates clear, high\-quality writing
* Ability to explain technical subjects accurately for an audience that includes engineers

**SEO**

* Hands\-on experience driving measurable SEO outcomes, whether professionally or through your own projects
* Strong understanding of on\-page SEO and enough technical SEO knowledge to identify problems and brief a developer

**Operating Style**

* Evidence that you own outcomes rather than simply completing assigned tasks
* Comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly
* Ability to work independently without needing constant direction

**Good to Have \-** 

* Effective use of AI tools for research, drafting, repurposing, and automation while keeping the writing genuinely human
* Experience with CMS platforms, Markdown, HTML, and Git
* Basic design skills using Figma, Canva, or similar
* Startup experience or personal projects
* Experience growing a content channel, website, or audience from scratch

**What Strong Looks Like \-** 

* You read about a product or feature and come back with a content strategy, not a list of questions
* You can connect published content to measurable traffic, ranking, or business outcomes
* You remove content that no longer performs because the data supports the decision
* You turn one piece of research into multiple high\-quality content formats without repeating yourself
* You decide what should be prioritized next and can defend it with data

**This Role Is Not For \-** 

* Writers who only hand content off for others to publish or optimize
* Candidates who describe SEO in terms of tools instead of outcomes
* People who need a content calendar handed to them instead of building one
* Writers looking for a narrowly scoped execution role without ownership

**Why Cidroy \-** 

Cidroy builds software for defence\-adjacent, industrial, and enterprise environments where reliability is critical. You'll work directly with a technical founding team in a fast\-moving environment with real ownership, short feedback loops, and meaningful impact.

description:
**About Us**
 At ANZ, we're applying new ways technology and data can be harnessed as we work towards a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.
   

  

 Our community of over 5,000 engineers is key to making this happen, because technology underpins every part of our business \- from delivering tools, apps and services for our customers, to building a bank for the future.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Data Engineer, this role is responsible for designing and building data flow and storage solutions, as well as performing data collation, wrangling, analysis, and visualisation of datasets
   

  

 We’re seeking a talented Data Engineer to join the Customer Data and Analytics tribe within our Retail division.
   

  

 In this role, you'll design and implement data processing solutions that support analytics, reporting, and data development across the division. You will drive best practice data engineering, challenge inefficient practices, and influence change to improve business outcomes. Your work will focus on delivering end\-to\-end solutions, uplifting the data engineering capability within the tribe, and aligning with the broader Enterprise Analytics roadmap.
   

  

 Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.
   

  

**Role Type: Permanent
   

  

 Role Location:Bengaluru
   

  

 Work Hours: 7 AM to 4 PM**
**What will your day look like?**
 As a Data Engineer, you will:
   

  

* Design data structures for data ingestion, integration and analytics layers on a variety of technologies
* Working in a cross skilled squad with people both from business and technology to build end to end features
* Contribute to design patterns for on\-premises and cloud.
* Optimise data flows by building robust, fault\-tolerant data pipeline that cleans, transforms, and aggregates unorganized and messy data into databases or data sources


**What will you bring?**
 To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:
   

  

* MS or BS in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or equivalent practical experience in Data Engineering
* A strong background in data processing and software engineering and can build high quality, scalable data products.
* Designing data structures for ingestion, integration, and analytics across various technologies.
* Collaborating, contributing to design patterns for both on\-premise and cloud environments, and optimizing data flows by creating robust, fault\-tolerant pipelines that clean, transform, and aggregate messy data into organized sources.


 You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.

description:
Electronics \& Control Panel Assembly Technician

**Company:** Carbelim Private Limited  
**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu  
**Department:** Production \& Manufacturing  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Work Mode:** On\-site  
**Reporting To:** Production Supervisor / Manufacturing Engineer

About Carbelim

Carbelim Private Limited is a climate\-tech company developing innovative microalgae\-powered solutions for air purification, carbon capture, clean\-air infrastructure, wastewater treatment, and sustainable urban development.

Our products integrate mechanical systems, electrical control panels, electronic components, sensors, IoT systems, LED assemblies, and automated monitoring technologies.

Position Overview

Carbelim is looking for a skilled and detail\-oriented **Electronics \& Control Panel Assembly Technician** to support its production and manufacturing operations.

The selected candidate will be responsible for assembling, wiring, soldering, testing, inspecting, and preparing electronic products, electrical control panels, PCB assemblies, LED systems, and associated components according to approved production drawings, wiring diagrams, standard operating procedures, and quality standards.

The candidate must be able to perform precise assembly work while maintaining product quality, electrical safety, workplace cleanliness, and production timelines.

Key ResponsibilitiesElectronic Assembly

* Assemble PCBs, electronic modules, sensors, controllers, and related components inside product enclosures.
* Mount electronic components according to approved assembly drawings and production instructions.
* Perform soldering, desoldering, wiring, crimping, and cable\-termination activities.
* Inspect solder joints, connectors, terminals, and electronic assemblies for proper workmanship.
* Assist with the integration of sensors, IoT modules, display units, and communication devices.
* Ensure that electronic components are handled according to electrostatic discharge safety procedures.

Control Panel Assembly

* Assemble and wire electrical and electronic control panels according to approved layouts and wiring diagrams.
* Mount and connect components such as:
* Switch\-mode power supplies
* Relays
* Contactors
* Circuit breakers
* Terminal blocks
* Controllers
* Communication modules
* Sensors
* Display units
* Electrical protection devices
* Prepare and install DIN rails, wiring ducts, terminal markers, labels, and panel accessories.
* Ensure that panel wiring is neat, properly routed, labelled, secured, and easy to maintain.
* Verify wire numbers, terminal connections, polarity, and component placement before testing.

Cable and Wiring Preparation

* Prepare cable harnesses according to approved production requirements.
* Perform wire cutting, stripping, crimping, ferruling, soldering, and termination.
* Install cable glands, connectors, sleeves, heat\-shrink tubes, and protective coverings.
* Apply appropriate cable labels and terminal identification.
* Maintain organised and professional cable\-management practices.
* Check cable continuity and connection accuracy before installation.

LED System Assembly

* Assemble LED strips, aluminium profiles, connectors, drivers, and diffusers.
* Cut and prepare LED strips according to product dimensions.
* Perform soldering and wiring of LED assemblies.
* Install LED profiles and lighting components neatly inside product structures.
* Test LED brightness, polarity, electrical connections, and functional performance.
* Identify and replace faulty LED strips, connectors, or power\-supply components.

Testing and Quality Inspection

* Perform basic electrical continuity, polarity, voltage, and functional testing.
* Use basic testing instruments such as:
* Digital multimeter
* Continuity tester
* Power supply
* Soldering station
* Wire and cable\-testing tools
* Conduct visual inspections to verify assembly quality and workmanship.
* Check products for loose connections, incorrect wiring, damaged components, and improper mounting.
* Support product testing and troubleshooting under the guidance of the production or engineering team.
* Record test results and communicate identified defects to the concerned supervisor.
* Carry out rework or corrective assembly activities when instructed.

Production and Documentation

* Follow approved assembly drawings, bill of materials, wiring diagrams, standard operating procedures, and production instructions.
* Complete assigned production activities within the planned timeline.
* Maintain production, testing, inspection, and material\-usage records.
* Report component shortages, damaged materials, assembly defects, and production delays immediately.
* Coordinate with production, electrical, electronics, mechanical, quality, and engineering teams.
* Support product packing and final preparation when required.
* Assist with prototype assembly and product\-development activities.

Safety and Workplace Management

* Follow all electrical, production, and workplace safety procedures.
* Maintain electrostatic discharge protection while handling sensitive electronic components.
* Use personal protective equipment wherever required.
* Keep tools, components, wires, workstations, and production areas clean and organised.
* Handle soldering equipment, electrical tools, and testing instruments safely.
* Avoid material wastage and ensure proper handling of company tools and equipment.
* Follow 5S and workplace housekeeping practices.

Required Qualifications

Candidates should possess one of the following qualifications:

* Diploma in Electronics and Communication Engineering
* Diploma in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
* Diploma in Mechatronics Engineering
* Diploma in Instrumentation and Control Engineering
* Diploma in Electrical Engineering
* ITI in Electronics Mechanic
* ITI in Electrician
* ITI in Wireman
* ITI in a related electrical or electronics discipline

Freshers with strong practical skills and relevant academic project experience may also apply.

Required Technical Skills

* Basic knowledge of electrical and electronic components.
* Good soldering and wiring skills.
* Ability to perform cable cutting, stripping, crimping, and ferruling.
* Ability to read basic wiring diagrams, assembly drawings, and electrical layouts.
* Basic knowledge of PCBs, relays, power supplies, terminal blocks, controllers, and sensors.
* Familiarity with hand tools, power tools, soldering stations, and assembly equipment.
* Basic knowledge of digital multimeter operation and continuity testing.
* Understanding of wire colour codes, polarity, and terminal identification.
* Ability to identify common electrical and electronic assembly defects.

title: IP Admin Senior Analyst
description:
We are looking for someone to join our IP Admin Team at Noida. This position exists to process correspondences issued by United States Patent \& Trademark office (PTO or USPTO), patent offices worldwide and the filing documents submitted in PTO during the patent \& trademarks life cycle. The main purpose of the role is to review, docket, de\-docket information received from PTOs, law firms, agents, and clients into Intellectual property management system (IPMS) and routing the said information to the appropriate attorneys or paralegals for action.
This is an exciting opportunity to work in the IP field where\-in, self\-improvement initiatives to drive client delight, building capability are added learnings.


We are the largest Intellectual Property Administrative service provider.

**Experience, Education, Skills, and Accomplishments**

* B.Sc. / M.Sc. B.Com, BBA, BCA, BA, MBA graduates with minimum 50% aggregate
* Freshers from 2025\-2026 Batch
* Experienced candidates should have a minimum of 18 months of work experience in Backend Operations
* Confident and proactive team player, with good interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently and efficiently with minimum / no supervision.

**It would be great if you also had . . .**

* IP Knowledge with experience to work on different IPMS' is added advantage and preferable.
* Good written \& verbal communication skills
* Basic MS office: Proficiency in Microsoft office suite programs, including Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Strong analytical skills to comprehensively evaluate the data.

**What will you be doing in this role?**

* Docketing: calendaring the statutory \& non\-statutory deadlines in Intellectual Property Management System (IPMS) along with relevant documents to preserve IP rights.
* De\-docketing: perform or close the calendared events in IPMS once the requisite action is completed or cancelled, respectively.
* Prioritize daily docketing/de\-docketing requests and other allocated tasks as agreed with client to complete in each day to keep IPMS current and correct.
* Review patent \& trademarks prosecution related documents (US \& Non\-US) received via mail or shared site and update / create the records in IPMS as per the standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Create and update patent \& trademarks records in IPMS along with family linking of direct and subject matter related (SMR) applications.
* Effective communication with Attorneys, Paralegals, Law firms, foreign agents, and other stake holders to seek instructions and clarification on certain tasks.
* Maintain the data integrity of IPMS and proactively monitoring the docket to ensure that all PTO \& client deadlines are met.
* Facilitate timely filing of all patent and trademarks application \& office action response through order letters and other required instructions.
* Facilitate accurate and timely payment of all PTO fees including the maintenance fees, coordinate with client for payment instructions and coordinate with annuity service providers or law firms.
* Abreast of changes in PTO guidelines and procedures and extend support to team with process related inputs.
* Training: Providing OJT’s to new joiners, conducting refresher trainings.
* Audits: Ability to perform internal and PTO Audits is preferred
* Quality Check: Should be able perform docketing Quality audits
* 1st level query resolution

**About the Team**


The team consists of 10\-15 members and is reporting to the Manager Operations.


Core process related responsibilities: IP docketing is the process of tracking deadlines related to the prosecution of patents, trademarks, and copyrights before their respective governing offices. This includes interacting with clients including external vendors \- Law firms, Annuity service providers etc., Quality Auditors, IP Operations function heads, Continuous Improvement team.

**Hours of Work**

* You will be working for works 40 hours/week (8 hrs a day; 5 days a week); you are entitled to get Overtime if you work beyond your working hours.
* This is a permanent job role.

You will work closely with the marketing team, sales team, and others to develop and execute effective digital marketing strategies that align with our business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and implement digital marketing strategies to drive online traffic to our website, increase brand awareness, and generate leads.
* Manage all aspects of digital marketing campaigns, including email marketing, social media marketing, search engine optimization (SEO), pay\-per\-click (PPC) advertising, content marketing, and online advertising.
* Create and manage content for our website, blog, social media channels, and other digital platforms to engage our target audience and drive conversions.

* Monitor and analyze the performance of digital marketing campaigns using web analytics tools and make data\-driven decisions to optimize campaign performance and ROI.

* Collaborate with the marketing team, sales team, and other departments to develop integrated marketing campaigns and ensure consistent messaging across all channels.
* Work closely with external agencies, vendors, and partners to execute digital marketing initiatives and achieve business goals.
* Manage digital marketing budgets and allocate resources effectively to maximize ROI.
* Maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders and communicate regularly on the progress of digital marketing initiatives, performance metrics, and upcoming campaigns.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
* Proven experience in digital marketing, with a minimum of 3\-5 years of experience in a similar role, preferably in the IT sector.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing channels, strategies, and techniques, including SEO, PPC, email marketing, social media marketing, and content marketing.
* Proficiency in video editing and graphic designing tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, Adobe Photoshop, and Illustrator.
* Proficiency in using digital marketing tools and platforms, such as Google Analytics, Google Ads, Facebook Ads Manager, Mailchimp, and Hootsuite.

* Creative thinking and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to develop innovative digital marketing strategies and campaigns that drive results.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to effectively communicate with internal teams, external partners, and stakeholders.
* Leadership skills and experience managing a team of digital marketing professionals, providing guidance, support, and mentorship to help them achieve their goals.
* Passion for technology and the IT industry, with a desire to stay updated on the latest trends, developments, and innovations in digital marketing and content creation.

**Why Join Us?** If you're passionate about digital marketing and multimedia content creation with a strong background in the IT sector, we'd love to hear from you! Join our team and help us drive growth and success through innovative digital marketing strategies and campaigns. Apply now!

**How to Apply:** Interested candidates should send their resume and a cover letter detailing their relevant experience with the subject line "Digital Marketing Manager Application".

title: Computer Lab Assistant
description:
Job Summary

The Computer Lab Assistant is responsible for the day\-to\-day operation, maintenance, and administration of computer laboratories. The role includes ensuring that computer systems, software, networks, and laboratory equipment function efficiently while providing technical support to students, faculty, and staff during practical sessions.

Key Responsibilities Laboratory Operations

* Open and prepare the laboratory before scheduled practical sessions.
* Ensure all computer systems are operational and ready for use.
* Maintain cleanliness and organization of the laboratory.
* Verify the availability of required hardware, peripherals, and software.

Technical Support

* Install, configure, and troubleshoot operating systems and software applications.
* Resolve hardware and software issues during laboratory sessions.
* Assist students and faculty with technical problems.
* Configure printers, scanners, projectors, and other peripherals.

Hardware Maintenance

* Perform routine maintenance of desktops, laptops, and servers.
* Replace faulty components such as RAM, SSDs, keyboards, mice, and power supplies.
* Report major hardware failures to the Lab In\-Charge.
* Maintain preventive maintenance schedules.

Software Management

* Install and update licensed software.
* Configure programming environments, IDEs, databases, and simulation software.
* Maintain antivirus and security updates.
* Ensure software licensing compliance.

Network Support

* Monitor LAN connectivity and internet availability.
* Configure network devices under the guidance of the network administrator.
* Report network failures promptly.
* Assist in maintaining Wi\-Fi connectivity within the laboratory.

Laboratory Inventory

* Maintain inventory records of computers, peripherals, and accessories.
* Label and track laboratory assets.
* Maintain issue/return registers for equipment.
* Report damaged or missing equipment.

Student \& Faculty Assistance

* Support faculty during practical classes.
* Assist students with laboratory exercises.
* Ensure students follow laboratory rules and safety procedures.
* Help organize workshops, FDPs, seminars, and technical events.

Documentation

* Maintain:
* Attendance registers
* Lab utilization records
* Maintenance logs
* Software installation records
* Asset registers
* Complaint and service registers
* Backup records

Data Backup \& Security

* Perform regular backups of important laboratory data.
* Ensure user accounts are properly managed.
* Monitor antivirus status and cybersecurity best practices.
* Prevent unauthorized installation of software.

Safety \& Compliance

* Follow institutional IT and laboratory policies.
* Ensure electrical safety and proper cable management.
* Report safety hazards immediately.
* Support compliance with institutional quality standards.

Required Qualifications

* Diploma/Bachelor's degree in:
* Computer Science
* Information Technology
* Computer Engineering
* Electronics
* Related field

Technical Skills

* Windows and Linux administration
* MS Office Suite
* Computer hardware troubleshooting
* LAN and basic networking
* Printer and scanner configuration
* Software installation and licensing
* Antivirus management
* Basic cybersecurity practices
* Database fundamentals
* Cloud storage and backup tools
* Basic scripting (PowerShell/Bash) is desirable

Soft Skills

* Good communication skills
* Problem\-solving ability
* Teamwork
* Time management
* Record keeping and documentation
* Customer service orientation
* Ability to work under pressure
* Attention to detail

Experience

* **Freshers** may apply.
* **1–3 years** of experience in computer laboratory administration or IT support is preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Laboratory uptime above **98%**
* Timely resolution of technical issues
* Zero software licensing violations
* Accurate inventory records
* Preventive maintenance completed as scheduled
* High faculty and student satisfaction
* Compliance with safety and security policies

Working Conditions

* Work in computer laboratories and classrooms.
* May require evening, weekend, or event support.
* Standing, lifting, and moving computer equipment may be required.

Preferred Certifications
